note.zh: 将 one main reason 改为 a primary cause 更正式，将 people 改为 clients 更准确，将 booked time 改为 scheduled time 更专业，将 far in advance 改为 well ahead of the appointment date 更具体。
note.en: Changing 'one main reason' to 'a primary cause' is more formal, 'people' to 'clients' is more precise, 'booked time' to 'scheduled time' is more professional, and 'far in advance' to 'well ahead of the appointment date' is more specific.

expressionEdits.before: One main reason is that people often forget their booked time
expressionEdits.after: A primary cause is that clients frequently forget their scheduled time

explanation.zh: 使用更正式的名词和更精确的术语。
explanation.en: Uses more formal nouns and precise terminology.

expressionEdits.before: far in advance
expressionEdits.after: well ahead of the appointment date

explanation.zh: 用更具体的表达替代模糊的时间短语。
explanation.en: Replaces a vague time phrase with a more specific expression.

translationZh.low: 一个主要原因是人们经常忘记预约时间，尤其是如果预约是很久以前做的。
translationZh.high: 一个主要原因是客户经常忘记他们安排的时间，特别是当预约是在预约日期之前很久做的。

segments.low: Without a reminder, a busy person can easily miss the slot and only remember after it has passed.
segments.high: Without a timely reminder, a busy individual may easily overlook the appointment and recall it only after the slot has elapsed.

note.zh: 将 a reminder 改为 a timely reminder 增加精确性，将 can easily miss 改为 may easily overlook 提升词汇，将 the slot 改为 the appointment 更清晰。
note.en: Adding 'timely' to 'a reminder' increases precision, 'can easily miss' to 'may easily overlook' upgrades vocabulary, and 'the slot' to 'the appointment' is clearer.

expressionEdits.before: Without a reminder, a busy person can easily miss the slot
expressionEdits.after: Without a timely reminder, a busy individual may easily overlook the appointment

explanation.zh: 增加修饰词并使用更高级的动词，使表达更精确。
explanation.en: Adds a modifier and uses a more advanced verb for precision.

translationZh.low: 如果没有提醒，忙碌的人很容易错过时段，并且只有在时段过去后才想起来。
translationZh.high: 如果没有及时的提醒，忙碌的人可能很容易忽略预约，并且只有在时段过去后才想起来。

segments.low: Another reason is that cancellation is too difficult or unclear, so people just do not bother to cancel.
segments.high: A further reason is that the cancellation process is overly complicated or poorly communicated, leading clients to simply avoid cancelling altogether.

note.zh: 将 too difficult or unclear 改为 overly complicated or poorly communicated 更具体，将 people 改为 clients，将 just do not bother 改为 simply avoid cancelling altogether 更正式，并使用 leading clients to 增强衔接。
note.en: Changing 'too difficult or unclear' to 'overly complicated or poorly communicated' is more specific, 'people' to 'clients', 'just do not bother' to 'simply avoid cancelling altogether' is more formal, and using 'leading clients to' improves cohesion.

translationZh.low: 另一个原因是取消太困难或不清楚，所以人们干脆不费心去取消。
translationZh.high: 另一个原因是取消过程过于复杂或沟通不畅，导致客户干脆完全避免取消。

segments.low: For example, if a centre only allows cancellation by phone during office hours, a working client may find it very inconvenient.
segments.high: For instance, if a centre permits cancellation only by telephone during business hours, a client with a full-time job could find this highly inconvenient.

note.zh: 将 office hours 改为 business hours 更常用，将 a working client 改为 a client with a full-time job 更具体，将 may find it very inconvenient 改为 could find this highly inconvenient 提升正式度。
note.en: Changing 'office hours' to 'business hours' is more common, 'a working client' to 'a client with a full-time job' is more specific, and 'may find it very inconvenient' to 'could find this highly inconvenient' increases formality.

translationZh.low: 例如，如果一个中心只允许在办公时间通过电话取消，一个工作的客户可能会觉得非常不方便。
translationZh.high: 例如，如果一个中心只允许在营业时间通过电话取消，一个全职工作的客户可能会觉得这非常不方便。

segments.low: In some cases, clients do not cancel because they are not sure about the rules or worry about losing their right to future services.
segments.high: In certain cases, clients refrain from cancelling because they are uncertain about the rules or fear that cancelling might jeopardise their access to future services.

note.zh: 将 do not cancel 改为 refrain from cancelling 更正式，将 worry about losing their right 改为 fear that cancelling might jeopardise their access 使用更高级词汇和更精确的表达。
note.en: Changing 'do not cancel' to 'refrain from cancelling' is more formal, and 'worry about losing their right' to 'fear that cancelling might jeopardise their access' uses higher-level vocabulary and more precise expression.

translationZh.low: 在某些情况下，客户不取消是因为他们不确定规则或担心失去未来服务的权利。
translationZh.high: 在某些情况下，客户不取消是因为他们不确定规则或担心取消可能会危及他们获得未来服务的机会。

segments.low: To reduce unused slots, centres could send automatic reminders by text message or email one or two days before the appointment.
segments.high: To minimise unused slots, centres could send automated reminders via text message or email one or two days prior to the scheduled appointment.

note.zh: 将 reduce 改为 minimise 更精确，将 automatic reminders 改为 automated reminders 更地道，将 before the appointment 改为 prior to the scheduled appointment 更正式。
note.en: Changing 'reduce' to 'minimise' is more precise, 'automatic reminders' to 'automated reminders' is more idiomatic, and 'before the appointment' to 'prior to the scheduled appointment' is more formal.

expressionEdits.before: reduce unused slots
expressionEdits.after: minimise unused slots

explanation.zh: 使用更精确的动词表达减少的程度。
explanation.en: Uses a more precise verb to express the degree of reduction.

expressionEdits.before: automatic reminders
expressionEdits.after: automated reminders

explanation.zh: 使用更地道的术语。
explanation.en: Uses a more idiomatic term.

translationZh.low: 为了减少未使用的时段，中心可以在预约前一两天通过短信或电子邮件发送自动提醒。
translationZh.high: 为了最大限度地减少未使用的时段，中心可以在预定预约前一两天通过短信或电子邮件发送自动提醒。

segments.low: This would help clients remember and give them a chance to cancel early if they cannot attend.
segments.high: Such reminders would help clients remember their appointments and provide an early opportunity to cancel if they are unable to attend.

note.zh: 将 this 改为 such reminders 增强衔接和指代清晰，将 give them a chance 改为 provide an early opportunity 更正式，增加 their appointments 使内容更完整。
note.en: Changing 'this' to 'such reminders' improves cohesion and reference clarity, 'give them a chance' to 'provide an early opportunity' is more formal, and adding 'their appointments' makes the content more complete.

expressionEdits.before: This would help clients remember
expressionEdits.after: Such reminders would help clients remember their appointments

explanation.zh: 使用更具体的指代并补充宾语，增强衔接和清晰度。
explanation.en: Uses a more specific reference and adds an object, improving cohesion and clarity.

translationZh.low: 这将帮助客户记住，并给他们一个机会，如果他们不能参加就早点取消。
translationZh.high: 这样的提醒将帮助客户记住他们的预约，并提供一个早期机会，如果他们无法参加就取消。

segments.low: Centres could also make cancellation much easier by offering online cancellation or a simple reply to the reminder message.
segments.high: Centres could also simplify cancellation by offering an online cancellation option or allowing clients to cancel by simply replying to the reminder message.

note.zh: 将 make cancellation much easier 改为 simplify cancellation 更简洁，将 offering online cancellation 改为 offering an online cancellation option 更具体，将 a simple reply 改为 allowing clients to cancel by simply replying 更清晰。
note.en: Changing 'make cancellation much easier' to 'simplify cancellation' is more concise, 'offering online cancellation' to 'offering an online cancellation option' is more specific, and 'a simple reply' to 'allowing clients to cancel by simply replying' is clearer.

translationZh.low: 中心也可以通过提供在线取消或对提醒消息的简单回复来使取消变得容易得多。
translationZh.high: 中心也可以通过提供在线取消选项或允许客户简单地回复提醒消息来简化取消。

segments.low: When cancellation is easy, more people will do it, and the centre can then offer the slot to someone else.
segments.high: When cancellation is straightforward, more clients are likely to do so, enabling the centre to offer the freed slot to another person.

note.zh: 将 easy 改为 straightforward 更正式，将 more people 改为 more clients 更准确，将 will do it 改为 are likely to do so 更严谨，使用 enabling the centre to 增强句子衔接。
note.en: Changing 'easy' to 'straightforward' is more formal, 'more people' to 'more clients' is more accurate, 'will do it' to 'are likely to do so' is more cautious, and using 'enabling the centre to' improves cohesion.

translationZh.low: 当取消很容易时，更多的人会这样做，然后中心可以把时段提供给其他人。
translationZh.high: 当取消很简单时，更多的客户可能会这样做，使中心能够把空出的时段提供给另一个人。

segments.low: Another useful measure is to keep a waiting list of clients who want earlier appointments, so empty slots can be filled quickly.
segments.high: An additional effective measure is to maintain a waiting list of clients seeking earlier appointments, allowing empty slots to be filled promptly.

note.zh: 将 useful 改为 effective 更准确，将 keep 改为 maintain 更正式，将 want earlier appointments 改为 seeking earlier appointments 更主动，将 quickly 改为 promptly 更正式。
note.en: Changing 'useful' to 'effective' is more accurate, 'keep' to 'maintain' is more formal, 'want earlier appointments' to 'seeking earlier appointments' is more active, and 'quickly' to 'promptly' is more formal.

translationZh.low: 另一个有用的措施是保留一份想要更早预约的客户等候名单，这样空的时段可以很快被填补。
translationZh.high: 另一个有效的措施是维护一份寻求更早预约的客户等候名单，使空的时段能够迅速被填补。

segments.low: In conclusion, unused appointment slots happen mainly because clients forget or find cancellation too difficult.
segments.high: In conclusion, unused appointment slots occur primarily because clients forget their bookings or find the cancellation process too burdensome.

note.zh: 将 happen 改为 occur 更正式，增加 their bookings 使内容更完整，将 too difficult 改为 too burdensome 提升词汇。
note.en: Changing 'happen' to 'occur' is more formal, adding 'their bookings' makes the content more complete, and 'too difficult' to 'too burdensome' upgrades vocabulary.

expressionEdits.before: unused appointment slots happen mainly because clients forget
expressionEdits.after: unused appointment slots occur primarily because clients forget their bookings

explanation.zh: 使用更正式的动词和副词，并补充宾语使表达更完整。
explanation.en: Uses a more formal verb and adverb, and adds an object for completeness.

expressionEdits.before: find cancellation too difficult
expressionEdits.after: find the cancellation process too burdensome

explanation.zh: 使用更高级的形容词并明确对象。
explanation.en: Uses a higher-level adjective and specifies the object.

translationZh.low: 总之，未使用的预约时段发生主要是因为客户忘记或觉得取消太困难。
translationZh.high: 总之，未使用的预约时段发生主要是因为客户忘记他们的预约或觉得取消过程太繁重。

segments.low: Centres can reduce this problem by sending reminders, simplifying cancellation, and using a waiting list to fill empty slots.
segments.high: Centres can mitigate this problem by sending reminders, streamlining cancellation procedures, and utilising a waiting list to fill vacant slots.

note.zh: 将 reduce 改为 mitigate 更正式，将 cancellation 改为 cancellation procedures 更具体，将 using 改为 utilising 提升词汇，将 empty slots 改为 vacant slots 更地道。
note.en: Changing 'reduce' to 'mitigate' is more formal, 'cancellation' to 'cancellation procedures' is more specific, 'using' to 'utilising' upgrades vocabulary, and 'empty slots' to 'vacant slots' is more idiomatic.

expressionEdits.before: reduce this problem
expressionEdits.after: mitigate this problem

explanation.zh: 使用更正式的动词。
explanation.en: Uses a more formal verb.

translationZh.low: 中心可以通过发送提醒、简化取消和使用等候名单来填补空时段来减少这个问题。
translationZh.high: 中心可以通过发送提醒、简化取消程序和使用等候名单来填补空时段来缓解这个问题。

note.zh: 低分版本和高分版本都充分回答了问题，提出了忘记和取消困难两个原因，并给出了提醒、简化取消和等候名单三个解决方案。高分版本在表达上更精确、更正式，但内容覆盖和结构相似。低分版本没有明显遗漏，但有些表达略显笼统。高分版本在细节上更具体，例如将'working client'改为'a client with a full-time job'。总体而言，两个版本都达到了任务要求，但高分版本在语言精度上更胜一筹。
note.en: Both versions fully address the question, presenting two causes (forgetting and difficult cancellation) and three solutions (reminders, simplifying cancellation, and waiting lists). The high version is more precise and formal in expression, but content coverage and structure are similar. The low version has no obvious omissions, but some expressions are slightly vague. The high version is more specific in details, such as changing 'working client' to 'a client with a full-time job'. Overall, both meet the task requirements, but the high version is superior in linguistic precision.

note.zh: 低分版本和高分版本都使用了清晰的段落结构和连接词，如'One main reason'、'Another reason'、'For example'、'In conclusion'。高分版本在句子内部衔接上更流畅，例如使用'leading clients to'和'enabling the centre to'等分词结构，使逻辑关系更紧密。低分版本有些句子之间略显跳跃，但整体连贯性可接受。高分版本通过更精确的指代和过渡词增强了段落内部的凝聚力。
note.en: Both versions use clear paragraph structure and linking words such as 'One main reason', 'Another reason', 'For example', and 'In conclusion'. The high version has smoother intra-sentence cohesion, for example using participial structures like 'leading clients to' and 'enabling the centre to', making logical connections tighter. The low version has some slight jumps between sentences, but overall coherence is acceptable. The high version enhances cohesion within paragraphs through more precise references and transitions.

note.zh: 高分版本在词汇上明显优于低分版本，使用了更多正式、精确和地道的表达，如'occasionally'、'straightforward forgetfulness'、'overly complicated'、'streamlining'、'mitigate'等。低分版本词汇较为简单和口语化，如'sometimes'、'simple forgetting'、'too difficult'、'make easier'、'reduce'。高分版本还避免了重复，使用了同义词替换，如'clients'替代'people'，'vacant slots'替代'empty slots'。整体词汇多样性更强。
note.en: The high version is clearly superior in vocabulary, using more formal, precise, and idiomatic expressions such as 'occasionally', 'straightforward forgetfulness', 'overly complicated', 'streamlining', and 'mitigate'. The low version uses simpler and more colloquial vocabulary like 'sometimes', 'simple forgetting', 'too difficult', 'make easier', and 'reduce'. The high version also avoids repetition through synonym substitution, such as 'clients' for 'people' and 'vacant slots' for 'empty slots'. Overall lexical variety is stronger.

note.zh: 两个版本的语法都基本正确，但高分版本使用了更复杂的句式结构，如分词短语、不定式结构和更长的名词短语，展示了更高的语法控制能力。低分版本句子结构相对简单，多为简单句和并列句。高分版本在时态和语态上更一致，且使用了更精确的情态动词如'could'和'may'。低分版本没有明显语法错误，但句式多样性不足。
note.en: Both versions are largely grammatically correct, but the high version uses more complex sentence structures, such as participial phrases, infinitive structures, and longer noun phrases, demonstrating greater grammatical control. The low version has relatively simpler sentence structures, mostly simple and compound sentences. The high version is more consistent in tense and voice, and uses more precise modal verbs like 'could' and 'may'. The low version has no obvious grammatical errors, but lacks sentence variety.

zh: 使用正式、精确的词汇替代口语化表达，如用'occasionally'替代'sometimes'，用'mitigate'替代'reduce'。
通过分词短语和不定式结构增强句子衔接，如'leading clients to'和'enabling the centre to'。
避免重复，使用同义词替换，如用'clients'替代'people'，用'vacant slots'替代'empty slots'。
en: Use formal and precise vocabulary instead of colloquial expressions, e.g., 'occasionally' for 'sometimes', 'mitigate' for 'reduce'.
Enhance cohesion with participial phrases and infinitive structures, e.g., 'leading clients to', 'enabling the centre to'.
Avoid repetition by using synonyms, e.g., 'clients' for 'people', 'vacant slots' for 'empty slots'.

taskAnalysis.zh: 本题要求分析社区服务中心预约空置的原因并提出解决方案。范文采用完全同意的立场，先分析原因（遗忘、取消不便），再提出措施（提醒、简化取消、候补名单），结构清晰，完全回应题目。
taskAnalysis.en: The question asks for causes of unused appointment slots and solutions. Both essays fully agree with the premise, first analysing causes (forgetfulness, inconvenient cancellation) then proposing measures (reminders, simplifying cancellation, waiting lists), clearly addressing all parts of the task.

role.zh: 引言：概述问题并指出主要原因方向
role.en: Introduction: outlines the problem and points to main causes

analysis.zh: 首段简要陈述问题（预约时段空置），并暗示原因与遗忘和取消不便有关，为下文展开做好铺垫。高分版本用词更正式（occasionally, unfilled, fail to attend, sufficient notice），句式更紧凑。
analysis.en: The first paragraph briefly states the problem (unfilled appointment slots) and hints at causes related to forgetfulness and inconvenient cancellation, setting the stage for the discussion. The high version uses more formal vocabulary (occasionally, unfilled, fail to attend, sufficient notice) and tighter sentence structure.

role.zh: 主体段一：分析原因（遗忘和取消不便）
role.en: Body paragraph 1: analyses causes (forgetfulness and inconvenient cancellation)

analysis.zh: 本段提出两个主要原因：客户遗忘预约时间；取消流程复杂或沟通不畅。通过举例（仅电话取消）和后果（担心失去服务）具体说明。高分版本用词更精准（primary cause, scheduled time, well ahead, overly complicated, poorly communicated, refrain from, jeopardise），逻辑连接更流畅。
analysis.en: This paragraph presents two main causes: clients forgetting their appointment times; and cancellation processes being complicated or poorly communicated. It provides examples (phone-only cancellation) and consequences (fear of losing services). The high version uses more precise vocabulary (primary cause, scheduled time, well ahead, overly complicated, poorly communicated, refrain from, jeopardise) and smoother logical connections.

role.zh: 主体段二：提出解决方案（提醒、简化取消、候补名单）
role.en: Body paragraph 2: proposes solutions (reminders, simplifying cancellation, waiting lists)

analysis.zh: 本段针对原因提出三项措施：发送自动提醒；简化取消方式（在线或回复短信）；建立候补名单。措施具体可行，与原因一一对应。高分版本用词更正式（minimise, automated reminders, prior to, simplify, straightforward, freed slot, maintain, promptly），表达更精炼。
analysis.en: This paragraph proposes three measures addressing the causes: sending automated reminders; simplifying cancellation (online or reply to message); maintaining a waiting list. The measures are specific and correspond to the causes. The high version uses more formal vocabulary (minimise, automated reminders, prior to, simplify, straightforward, freed slot, maintain, promptly) and more concise expression.

role.zh: 结论：总结原因和解决方案
role.en: Conclusion: summarises causes and solutions

analysis.zh: 结论段重申问题产生的主要原因（遗忘和取消不便）及对应解决方案（提醒、简化取消、候补名单），首尾呼应。高分版本用词更准确（occur primarily, burdensome, mitigate, streamlining, utilising, vacant slots），避免重复。
analysis.en: The conclusion restates the main causes (forgetfulness and inconvenient cancellation) and corresponding solutions (reminders, simplifying cancellation, waiting lists), echoing the introduction. The high version uses more precise vocabulary (occur primarily, burdensome, mitigate, streamlining, utilising, vacant slots) and avoids repetition.

title.zh: 使用具体例子支持论点
title.en: Using specific examples to support points

explanation.zh: 在分析取消不便的原因时，低分版本举例“如果中心只允许在工作时间通过电话取消，全职客户会觉得很不方便”，高分版本改为“例如，如果中心只允许在工作时间通过电话取消，全职工作的客户会觉得非常不便”，使论点更具说服力。具体例子让抽象原因变得可感知，增强论证力度。
explanation.en: When analysing the cause of inconvenient cancellation, the low version gives the example 'if a centre only allows cancellation by phone during office hours, a working client may find it very inconvenient', while the high version refines it to 'For instance, if a centre permits cancellation only by telephone during business hours, a client with a full-time job could find this highly inconvenient', making the point more persuasive. Specific examples make abstract causes tangible and strengthen the argument.

title.zh: 使用并列结构清晰列举措施
title.en: Using parallel structure to list measures clearly

explanation.zh: 在提出解决方案时，低分版本使用“Centres could also make cancellation much easier by offering online cancellation or a simple reply to the reminder message.”，高分版本改为“Centres could also simplify cancellation by offering an online cancellation option or allowing clients to cancel by simply replying to the reminder message.”，通过并列的动名词短语（offering... or allowing...）使列举更加清晰、整齐，增强了表达的条理性。
explanation.en: When proposing solutions, the low version uses 'Centres could also make cancellation much easier by offering online cancellation or a simple reply to the reminder message.', while the high version refines it to 'Centres could also simplify cancellation by offering an online cancellation option or allowing clients to cancel by simply replying to the reminder message.', using parallel gerund phrases (offering... or allowing...) to make the list clearer and more orderly, enhancing coherence.

title.zh: 使用因果逻辑连接措施与效果
title.en: Using cause-effect logic to connect measures and outcomes

explanation.zh: 在说明简化取消的好处时，低分版本写“When cancellation is easy, more people will do it, and the centre can then offer the slot to someone else.”，高分版本改为“When cancellation is straightforward, more clients are likely to do so, enabling the centre to offer the freed slot to another person.”，通过现在分词短语“enabling...”明确表达因果关系，使逻辑更紧密，句式更高级。
explanation.en: When explaining the benefit of simplifying cancellation, the low version writes 'When cancellation is easy, more people will do it, and the centre can then offer the slot to someone else.', while the high version refines it to 'When cancellation is straightforward, more clients are likely to do so, enabling the centre to offer the freed slot to another person.', using the present participle phrase 'enabling...' to explicitly express cause and effect, making the logic tighter and the sentence more sophisticated.

mistakes.zh: 低分版本中“simple forgetting”表达不够正式，且“cancellation processes that are not easy for people to use”略显冗长。高分版本改为“straightforward forgetfulness”和“cancellation procedures that are inconvenient for clients”，用词更准确、正式，句式更紧凑。
mistakes.en: In the low version, 'simple forgetting' is not formal enough, and 'cancellation processes that are not easy for people to use' is slightly wordy. The high version changes these to 'straightforward forgetfulness' and 'cancellation procedures that are inconvenient for clients', using more precise, formal vocabulary and a tighter structure.

mistakes.zh: 低分版本中“people just do not bother to cancel”语气过于口语化，且“do not bother”带有轻微贬义。高分版本改为“leading clients to simply avoid cancelling altogether”，表达更中性、正式，且用“leading”明确因果关系。
mistakes.en: In the low version, 'people just do not bother to cancel' is too colloquial, and 'do not bother' carries a slightly negative connotation. The high version changes this to 'leading clients to simply avoid cancelling altogether', which is more neutral and formal, and uses 'leading' to explicitly show cause and effect.

meaning.en: not filled; vacant

usage.zh: 通常用于描述职位、名额、时段等未被占用。在此语境中修饰“appointment slots”，表示预约时段空置。注意与“empty”的区别：“unfilled”更正式，强调本应被填补但未填补。
usage.en: Typically used to describe positions, slots, or time periods that are not occupied. Here it modifies 'appointment slots', meaning the slots are vacant. Note the difference from 'empty': 'unfilled' is more formal and emphasises that something should have been filled but was not.

example.zh: 由于临时取消，该诊所空置了好几个预约时段。
example.en: The clinic had several unfilled appointment slots due to last-minute cancellations.

meaning.en: enough advance warning

usage.zh: 常用于正式场合，表示在某个截止时间前给予足够的时间告知。在此语境中，指客户取消预约时未能提前足够时间通知。常与动词“give”或“provide”搭配。
usage.en: Commonly used in formal contexts to mean giving enough time in advance before a deadline. Here it means clients did not inform the centre far enough in advance when cancelling. Often collocates with 'give' or 'provide'.

example.zh: 租户在终止租约前必须提前足够时间通知。
example.en: Tenants must give sufficient notice before terminating the lease.

meaning.zh: 简单明了的；直截了当的
meaning.en: simple and easy to understand

usage.zh: 形容过程、方法等不复杂。在此语境中修饰“cancellation”，表示取消流程简单。注意与“simple”的区别：“straightforward”强调没有隐藏的复杂性或歧义。
usage.en: Describes a process or method that is not complicated. Here it modifies 'cancellation', meaning the cancellation process is simple. Note the difference from 'simple': 'straightforward' emphasises the absence of hidden complexity or ambiguity.

example.zh: 这个在线预订系统简单明了，易于使用。
example.en: The online booking system is straightforward and user-friendly.

meaning.en: to put something at risk

usage.zh: 正式用词，表示使某事物处于危险之中。在此语境中指客户担心取消预约会损害他们未来获得服务的机会。常与“chances”、“access”、“reputation”等搭配。
usage.en: A formal word meaning to put something at risk. Here it means clients fear that cancelling might harm their future access to services. Often collocates with 'chances', 'access', 'reputation', etc.

example.zh: 错过截止日期可能会危及你的申请。
example.en: Missing the deadline could jeopardise your application.

meaning.en: to make something less severe or harmful

usage.zh: 正式用词，常用于描述减轻问题、风险、影响等。在此语境中指中心可以减轻预约空置问题。注意与“solve”的区别：“mitigate”表示减轻而非完全解决。
usage.en: A formal word used to describe reducing the severity of a problem, risk, or impact. Here it means centres can reduce the problem of unused slots. Note the difference from 'solve': 'mitigate' means to lessen, not eliminate.

example.zh: 植树有助于减轻气候变化的影响。
example.en: Planting trees can help mitigate the effects of climate change.

meaning.en: making a process more efficient by simplifying it

usage.zh: 常用于商业或管理语境，表示简化流程以提高效率。在此语境中指简化取消程序。常与“process”、“procedure”、“operations”等搭配。
usage.en: Often used in business or management contexts to mean simplifying a process to make it more efficient. Here it refers to simplifying cancellation procedures. Often collocates with 'process', 'procedure', 'operations', etc.

example.zh: 该公司正在精简申请流程以减少等待时间。
example.en: The company is streamlining its application process to reduce waiting times.

prompt.en: Residents sometimes disagree about noise from evening activities in shared public spaces. What causes these conflicts, and what could local authorities and users do to resolve them? Write at least 250 words.
prompt.zh: 居民有时会因共享公共空间中的晚间活动噪声产生分歧。这些冲突有哪些成因？地方管理部门和使用者可以怎样化解？不少于 250 词。

title.zh: 共享公共空间的噪声冲突
title.en: Noise Conflicts in Shared Public Spaces

segments.low: Noise disagreements in shared public spaces usually happen because evening time is not clearly defined for different activities, and this can affect many neighbourhoods.
segments.high: Noise disagreements in shared public spaces usually happen because evening time is not clearly defined for different activities, and this ambiguity affects many neighbourhoods.

note.zh: 用名词短语“this ambiguity”替代“this”，指代更明确，衔接更紧凑。
note.en: Replacing 'this' with the noun phrase 'this ambiguity' makes the reference clearer and improves cohesion.

expressionEdits.before: this can affect
expressionEdits.after: this ambiguity affects

explanation.zh: 将代词替换为具体名词短语，增强指代清晰度和衔接。
explanation.en: Replacing the pronoun with a specific noun phrase enhances clarity and cohesion.

translationZh.low: 共享公共空间中的噪声分歧通常发生，因为晚间时间对不同活动没有明确界定，这会影响许多社区。
translationZh.high: 共享公共空间中的噪声分歧通常发生，因为晚间时间对不同活动没有明确界定，这种模糊性影响许多社区。

segments.low: Some residents want to use these places for social events or sports, while others need quiet for rest after work.
segments.high: While some residents wish to use these areas for social gatherings or exercise, others need relative quiet to recover after their working day.

note.zh: 用“While...others...”结构替代“Some...while others...”，句式更紧凑，词汇更正式。
note.en: Using 'While...others...' instead of 'Some...while others...' makes the sentence more compact and the vocabulary more formal.

translationZh.low: 一些居民想把这些地方用于社交活动或运动，而其他人下班后需要安静休息。
translationZh.high: 虽然一些居民希望将这些区域用于社交聚会或锻炼，但其他人需要相对安静来从工作日中恢复。

segments.low: One main cause is that the same space is used for many purposes, like playgrounds, walking paths, and open squares.
segments.high: A primary cause is that a single space often serves multiple functions, such as a playground, a walking route, and an informal meeting area.

note.zh: 用“serves multiple functions”等更正式表达替换“is used for many purposes”，提升词汇丰富度。
note.en: Replacing 'is used for many purposes' with 'serves multiple functions' improves lexical range and formality.

expressionEdits.before: is used for many purposes
expressionEdits.after: serves multiple functions

explanation.zh: 使用更正式、更地道的动词短语。
explanation.en: Using a more formal and idiomatic verb phrase.

translationZh.low: 一个主要原因是同一空间被用于多种用途，如游乐场、步行道和开放广场。
translationZh.high: 一个主要原因是单一空间往往具有多种功能，例如游乐场、步行路线和非正式聚会区。

segments.low: When these uses overlap in the evening, sound from one group can easily disturb another group nearby.
segments.high: When these uses overlap in the evening, sound from one group can easily disturb another group nearby, especially in densely built residential areas.

note.zh: 增加“尤其是在建筑密集的住宅区”这一细节，使论述更具体、更有说服力。
note.en: Adding the detail 'especially in densely built residential areas' makes the argument more specific and persuasive.

expressionEdits.before: disturb another group nearby.
expressionEdits.after: disturb another group nearby, especially in densely built residential areas.

explanation.zh: 添加具体情境，增强任务回应充分性。
explanation.en: Adding specific context enhances task achievement.

translationZh.low: 当这些用途在晚间重叠时，一组人的声音很容易打扰附近的另一组人。
translationZh.high: 当这些用途在晚间重叠时，一组人的声音很容易打扰附近的另一组人，尤其是在建筑密集的住宅区。

segments.low: For example, a group playing music near a bench area may not realise that residents in nearby flats can hear everything clearly.
segments.high: For instance, a group playing music near a seating area may not realise that residents in adjacent apartments can hear every note distinctly.

note.zh: 用“adjacent apartments”和“every note distinctly”等更精确的词汇替换，增强表达效果。
note.en: Using more precise vocabulary such as 'adjacent apartments' and 'every note distinctly' enhances expression.

expressionEdits.before: nearby flats can hear everything clearly
expressionEdits.after: adjacent apartments can hear every note distinctly

explanation.zh: 词汇更具体、更生动。
explanation.en: Vocabulary is more specific and vivid.

translationZh.low: 例如，一群人在长椅区附近播放音乐，可能没有意识到附近公寓的居民能清楚地听到一切。
translationZh.high: 例如，一群人在座位区附近播放音乐，可能没有意识到相邻公寓的居民能清晰地听到每一个音符。

segments.low: Another cause is that there is no clear rule about when evening noise should be reduced.
segments.high: A second cause is the absence of clear guidance on when evening noise levels should be lowered.

note.zh: 用名词短语“the absence of clear guidance”替代“there is no clear rule”，句式更正式、简洁。
note.en: Replacing 'there is no clear rule' with the noun phrase 'the absence of clear guidance' makes the sentence more formal and concise.

translationZh.low: 另一个原因是关于晚间何时应降低噪声没有明确规则。
translationZh.high: 第二个原因是缺乏关于晚间何时应降低噪声水平的明确指导。

segments.low: People have different ideas about what is too loud, so the same sound can be fine for one person but annoying for another.
segments.high: Because individuals have different thresholds for acceptable volume, the same sound may seem harmless to one person yet intrusive to another.

note.zh: 使用“Because”引导的原因状语从句和更正式的词汇（如“thresholds”“intrusive”）提升逻辑和词汇。
note.en: Using a 'Because' clause and more formal vocabulary (e.g., 'thresholds', 'intrusive') improves logic and lexis.

translationZh.low: 人们对什么算太吵有不同的看法，所以同样的声音对一个人来说可能没问题，但对另一个人来说却很烦人。
translationZh.high: 由于个体对可接受音量的阈值不同，同样的声音对一个人来说可能无害，但对另一个人来说却具有侵扰性。

segments.low: Local authorities could solve this by dividing public spaces into zones for active and quiet use.
segments.high: Local authorities could solve this by dividing public spaces into zones for active and quiet use, which is a practical first step.

note.zh: 添加“这是切实可行的第一步”这一评价，使建议更具说服力，体现批判性思维。
note.en: Adding the evaluation 'which is a practical first step' makes the suggestion more persuasive and shows critical thinking.

expressionEdits.before: quiet use.
expressionEdits.after: quiet use, which is a practical first step.

explanation.zh: 增加评价性从句，增强论证深度。
explanation.en: Adding an evaluative clause enhances depth of argument.

translationZh.low: 地方当局可以通过将公共空间划分为活跃使用区和安静使用区来解决这个问题。
translationZh.high: 地方当局可以通过将公共空间划分为活跃使用区和安静使用区来解决这个问题，这是切实可行的第一步。

segments.low: They could also set agreed evening times after which certain noisy activities are not allowed.
segments.high: They could also establish agreed evening cut-off times after which particular noisy activities are no longer permitted.

note.zh: 用“establish agreed evening cut-off times”和“no longer permitted”等更正式词汇替换。
note.en: Replacing with more formal vocabulary such as 'establish agreed evening cut-off times' and 'no longer permitted'.

expressionEdits.before: set agreed evening times
expressionEdits.after: establish agreed evening cut-off times

explanation.zh: 使用更正式、更具体的表达。
explanation.en: Using more formal and specific expression.

translationZh.low: 他们还可以设定商定的晚间时间，之后某些嘈杂活动不被允许。
translationZh.high: 他们还可以建立商定的晚间截止时间，之后特定嘈杂活动不再被允许。

segments.low: Also, they can put up signs that explain the rules and ask users to respect neighbours.
segments.high: Also, they can put up signs that explain the rules and ask users to respect neighbours, making the expectations visible to everyone.

note.zh: 增加结果状语“使期望对每个人都可见”，强调措施效果，完善论证。
note.en: Adding the result clause 'making the expectations visible to everyone' emphasises the effect of the measure and completes the argument.

expressionEdits.before: respect neighbours.
expressionEdits.after: respect neighbours, making the expectations visible to everyone.

explanation.zh: 补充结果，使建议更完整。
explanation.en: Adding a result to make the suggestion more complete.

translationZh.low: 此外，他们可以张贴解释规则并要求使用者尊重邻居的标志。
translationZh.high: 此外，他们可以张贴解释规则并要求使用者尊重邻居的标志，使期望对每个人都可见。

segments.low: Users can help by talking with each other and agreeing on times for louder activities.
segments.high: Users themselves can contribute by communicating with one another and agreeing on suitable times for louder pursuits.

note.zh: 用“contribute”替换“help”，用“communicating”替换“talking”，词汇更正式、准确。
note.en: Replacing 'help' with 'contribute' and 'talking' with 'communicating' makes vocabulary more formal and precise.

translationZh.low: 使用者可以通过相互交谈并就较嘈杂活动的时间达成一致来提供帮助。
translationZh.high: 使用者自己可以通过相互沟通并就适合的较嘈杂活动时间达成一致来做出贡献。

segments.low: For example, a sports group could agree to finish by nine o'clock so families with young children can sleep.
segments.high: For example, a sports group could agree to finish by nine o'clock so that families with young children are not disturbed at bedtime.

note.zh: 用“are not disturbed at bedtime”替代“can sleep”，表达更具体、更贴切。
note.en: Replacing 'can sleep' with 'are not disturbed at bedtime' is more specific and appropriate.

translationZh.low: 例如，一个体育团体可以同意在九点前结束，以便有小孩的家庭可以睡觉。
translationZh.high: 例如，一个体育团体可以同意在九点前结束，以便有小孩的家庭在就寝时间不受打扰。

segments.low: In conclusion, these conflicts come from mixed uses and unclear evening expectations.
segments.high: In conclusion, these conflicts come from mixed uses and unclear evening expectations in shared public spaces.

note.zh: 在结论中重申“共享公共空间”这一背景，使总结更完整、扣题。
note.en: Reiterating 'in shared public spaces' in the conclusion makes the summary more complete and on-topic.

expressionEdits.before: unclear evening expectations.
expressionEdits.after: unclear evening expectations in shared public spaces.

explanation.zh: 补充地点状语，强化主题。
explanation.en: Adding an adverbial of place to reinforce the topic.

translationZh.low: 总之，这些冲突源于混合用途和不明确的晚间期望。
translationZh.high: 总之，这些冲突源于共享公共空间中混合用途和不明确的晚间期望。

segments.low: If authorities create clear zones and times, and users cooperate with each other, both activity and rest can be respected.
segments.high: If authorities establish clear zones and time limits, and users cooperate with one another, both recreation and rest can be reasonably accommodated.

note.zh: 用“establish”“time limits”“reasonably accommodated”等更正式词汇替换，提升语言质量。
note.en: Replacing with more formal vocabulary such as 'establish', 'time limits', and 'reasonably accommodated' improves language quality.

expressionEdits.before: create clear zones and times
expressionEdits.after: establish clear zones and time limits

explanation.zh: 使用更正式、更准确的表达。
explanation.en: Using more formal and precise expression.

translationZh.low: 如果当局创建明确的区域和时间，使用者相互合作，活动和休息都能得到尊重。
translationZh.high: 如果当局建立明确的区域和时间限制，使用者相互合作，娱乐和休息都能得到合理兼顾。

note.zh: 高分版本通过添加具体细节（如“建筑密集的住宅区”“切实可行的第一步”）和更精确的总结，更充分地回应了任务要求，论证更充实。低分版本已涵盖主要观点，但部分论证略显笼统。两者均未讨论冲突的深层社会因素，但整体任务完成度良好。
note.en: The high version responds more fully to the task by adding specific details (e.g., 'densely built residential areas', 'a practical first step') and a more precise summary, making the argument more substantial. The low version covers the main points but some arguments are slightly general. Neither discusses deeper social factors of the conflict, but overall task achievement is good.

note.zh: 高分版本在衔接上更胜一筹，例如使用“this ambiguity”替代“this”使指代更清晰，使用“While...others...”结构使句子更紧凑。低分版本逻辑连贯，但部分句子结构简单，衔接手段单一。整体段落组织合理，但高分版本的连贯性更强。
note.en: The high version has better cohesion, for example using 'this ambiguity' instead of 'this' for clearer reference and using 'While...others...' structure for more compact sentences. The low version is logically coherent but some sentence structures are simple and cohesive devices are limited. Overall paragraph organisation is reasonable, but the high version has stronger coherence.

note.zh: 高分版本使用了更丰富、更正式的词汇，如“serves multiple functions”“adjacent apartments”“thresholds”“intrusive”“establish”“cut-off times”等，展现了较强的词汇能力。低分版本词汇基本准确但较为普通，如“used for many purposes”“nearby flats”“different ideas”等。高分版本在词汇多样性上明显优于低分版本。
note.en: The high version uses a wider range of more formal vocabulary, such as 'serves multiple functions', 'adjacent apartments', 'thresholds', 'intrusive', 'establish', 'cut-off times', demonstrating stronger lexical resource. The low version has generally accurate but more common vocabulary, such as 'used for many purposes', 'nearby flats', 'different ideas'. The high version is clearly superior in lexical variety.

note.zh: 两个版本的语法准确性都较高，无明显错误。高分版本使用了更多样的句式，如原因状语从句、非限定性定语从句、被动语态等，语法范围更广。低分版本句式相对简单，但也能正确使用复合句。整体而言，高分版本在语法多样性和复杂性上更胜一筹。
note.en: Both versions have high grammatical accuracy with no obvious errors. The high version uses a greater variety of sentence structures, such as causal clauses, non-defining relative clauses, and passive voice, showing a wider grammatical range. The low version has relatively simpler structures but still uses complex sentences correctly. Overall, the high version is superior in grammatical variety and complexity.

taskAnalysis.zh: 题目要求分析共享公共空间晚间活动噪声分歧的原因，并提出地方管理部门和使用者的解决措施。范文采用清晰的原因-解决方案结构，完整回应两个问题。
taskAnalysis.en: The prompt asks for causes of noise conflicts from evening activities in shared public spaces and solutions by authorities and users. The essays follow a clear cause-solution structure, fully addressing both parts.

role.zh: 引言段：提出话题并概括冲突的核心原因——晚间时间界定模糊。
role.en: Introduction: presents the topic and summarises the core cause—unclear definition of evening time.

analysis.zh: 该段开门见山指出噪声分歧通常源于晚间时间对不同活动缺乏明确界定，并用‘这种模糊性影响许多社区’点明普遍性。第二句通过对比不同居民需求，为后文展开原因和解决方案铺垫。高分版本用‘relative quiet’和‘recover after their working day’更精准地描述休息需求，避免了低分版本中‘need quiet’的绝对化表达。
analysis.en: This paragraph directly states that noise disagreements typically stem from the lack of a clear definition of evening time for different activities, and highlights the widespread impact with 'this ambiguity affects many neighbourhoods.' The second sentence contrasts residents' needs, setting the stage for the causes and solutions. The high version uses 'relative quiet' and 'recover after their working day' to describe rest needs more precisely, avoiding the absolute phrasing 'need quiet' in the low version.

role.zh: 主体段一：分析冲突的两个主要原因——空间多功能混合使用和缺乏明确的晚间降噪规定。
role.en: Body paragraph 1: analyses two main causes—mixed use of spaces and lack of clear evening noise regulations.

analysis.zh: 该段先指出同一空间常承担多种功能，如游乐场、步行道和非正式聚会区，功能重叠时噪声容易干扰附近居民。随后用音乐团体在座位区附近演奏的例子具体说明，并补充第二个原因：缺乏何时应降低晚间噪声的明确指导。最后解释个体对音量的接受阈值不同，导致同一声音感知差异。高分版本用‘densely built residential areas’和‘adjacent apartments’强化了空间邻近性，用‘thresholds for acceptable volume’比低分版本‘different ideas about what is too loud’更学术化。
analysis.en: The paragraph first notes that a single space often serves multiple functions, such as a playground, walking route, and informal meeting area, and when these uses overlap, noise can easily disturb nearby residents. It then illustrates with the example of a music group near a seating area, and adds a second cause: the absence of clear guidance on when evening noise should be lowered. Finally, it explains that individuals have different thresholds for acceptable volume. The high version strengthens spatial proximity with 'densely built residential areas' and 'adjacent apartments,' and uses 'thresholds for acceptable volume' more academically than 'different ideas about what is too loud.'

role.zh: 主体段二：提出地方管理部门和使用者双方可行的解决措施。
role.en: Body paragraph 2: proposes feasible solutions by local authorities and users.

analysis.zh: 该段分别从管理方和使用者角度提出措施。管理方可将公共空间划分为活跃区和安静区，设定晚间禁止特定噪声活动的截止时间，并张贴规则标志。使用者可通过沟通协商较喧闹活动的合适时间，例如运动团体同意九点前结束以免打扰有幼儿的家庭。高分版本用‘practical first step’和‘making the expectations visible’强调措施的可操作性和透明性，用‘pursuits’替代‘activities’增加词汇多样性，用‘are not disturbed at bedtime’比‘can sleep’更委婉具体。
analysis.en: This paragraph proposes measures from both authorities and users. Authorities can divide public spaces into active and quiet zones, set evening cut-off times for noisy activities, and post signs explaining rules. Users can communicate and agree on suitable times for louder activities, such as a sports group finishing by nine o'clock to avoid disturbing families with young children. The high version uses 'practical first step' and 'making the expectations visible' to emphasise feasibility and transparency, uses 'pursuits' instead of 'activities' for variety, and 'are not disturbed at bedtime' is more tactful and specific than 'can sleep.'

role.zh: 结论段：总结冲突根源并重申管理方和使用者合作的重要性。
role.en: Conclusion: summarises the root causes and reiterates the importance of cooperation between authorities and users.

analysis.zh: 该段简洁总结冲突源于混合用途和晚间期望不明确，并指出若管理方建立清晰区域和时间限制，使用者相互合作，娱乐与休息都能得到合理兼顾。高分版本在首句末尾补充‘in shared public spaces’使主题更完整，用‘establish clear zones and time limits’比‘create clear zones and times’更正式，用‘reasonably accommodated’比‘respected’更能体现平衡与可行性。
analysis.en: This paragraph concisely summarises that conflicts stem from mixed uses and unclear evening expectations, and states that if authorities establish clear zones and time limits and users cooperate, both recreation and rest can be reasonably accommodated. The high version adds 'in shared public spaces' at the end of the first sentence for completeness, uses 'establish clear zones and time limits' more formally than 'create clear zones and times,' and 'reasonably accommodated' better conveys balance and feasibility than 'respected.'

title.zh: 对比与让步结构
title.en: Contrast and concession structure

explanation.zh: 在引言段使用‘While some residents wish to... others need...’的对比结构，既呈现不同群体的需求冲突，又为后文分析原因和提出平衡方案奠定基础。这种结构使开篇观点鲜明，且避免绝对化表述。高分版本用‘relative quiet’和‘recover after their working day’更精准地描述‘休息’需求，体现了语言的准确性。
explanation.en: The introduction uses the contrast structure 'While some residents wish to... others need...' to present the conflicting needs of different groups, laying the foundation for analysing causes and proposing balanced solutions. This structure makes the opening viewpoint clear and avoids absolute statements. The high version uses 'relative quiet' and 'recover after their working day' to describe rest needs more precisely, demonstrating linguistic accuracy.

title.zh: 具体例证支撑论点
title.en: Specific examples to support arguments

explanation.zh: 在主体段中，通过‘For instance, a group playing music near a seating area...’和‘For example, a sports group could agree to finish by nine o'clock...’两个具体例子，分别说明噪声干扰的实际场景和用户协商的可行方案。例子贴近生活，增强了论证的说服力。高分版本将‘bench area’改为‘seating area’，‘nearby flats’改为‘adjacent apartments’，用词更正式准确。
explanation.en: In the body paragraphs, the examples 'For instance, a group playing music near a seating area...' and 'For example, a sports group could agree to finish by nine o'clock...' illustrate actual noise disturbance scenarios and feasible user agreements. These relatable examples strengthen the argument. The high version changes 'bench area' to 'seating area' and 'nearby flats' to 'adjacent apartments,' using more formal and precise vocabulary.

title.zh: 分层提出解决方案
title.en: Layered presentation of solutions

explanation.zh: 解决方案段从管理方和使用者两个层面展开，管理方措施包括分区、设定截止时间和张贴标志，使用者措施包括沟通协商和具体时间约定。这种分层结构使方案全面且逻辑清晰。高分版本在每项措施后添加评价性短语，如‘which is a practical first step’和‘making the expectations visible to everyone’，增强了措施的可行性和透明度。
explanation.en: The solutions paragraph is organised into two layers: authorities' measures include zoning, setting cut-off times, and posting signs; users' measures include communication and specific time agreements. This layered structure makes the solutions comprehensive and logically clear. The high version adds evaluative phrases after each measure, such as 'which is a practical first step' and 'making the expectations visible to everyone,' enhancing feasibility and transparency.

mistakes.zh: 低分版本第0句使用‘this can affect many neighbourhoods’，其中‘can affect’表达可能性，但此处应强调实际影响，高分版本改为‘this ambiguity affects many neighbourhoods’，用一般现在时直接陈述事实，语气更肯定，逻辑更紧密。
mistakes.en: In sentence 0, the low version uses 'this can affect many neighbourhoods,' where 'can affect' expresses possibility, but the intended meaning is actual impact. The high version changes it to 'this ambiguity affects many neighbourhoods,' using the simple present to state a fact, making the tone more assertive and the logic tighter.

mistakes.zh: 低分版本第3句缺少对空间特征的描述，仅说‘sound from one group can easily disturb another group nearby’，而高分版本补充‘especially in densely built residential areas’，强调了建筑密度对噪声传播的影响，使原因分析更具体、更有说服力。
mistakes.en: In sentence 3, the low version lacks a description of spatial characteristics, only stating 'sound from one group can easily disturb another group nearby.' The high version adds 'especially in densely built residential areas,' emphasising the impact of building density on noise propagation, making the cause analysis more specific and persuasive.

meaning.en: The state of being unclear or having more than one possible meaning

usage.zh: 常用于正式或学术语境，指规则、定义或表述的不清晰。可作可数或不可数名词。在本句中指‘晚间时间界定’的模糊性。注意不要与‘ambiguousness’混淆，后者较少使用。
usage.en: Commonly used in formal or academic contexts to refer to lack of clarity in rules, definitions, or statements. Can be countable or uncountable. In this sentence, it refers to the vagueness of the definition of evening time. Avoid confusion with 'ambiguousness,' which is rarely used.

example.zh: 规定中的模糊性导致居民感到困惑。
example.en: The ambiguity in the regulations led to confusion among residents.

meaning.en: A level of quietness that is considered in comparison to other conditions or expectations

usage.zh: ‘relative’修饰‘quiet’，表示安静程度是相对的，而非绝对无声。常用于描述环境噪声标准。在本句中，强调居民需要的是相对于白天活动的安静，而非完全寂静。使用时注意‘quiet’为不可数名词。
usage.en: 'Relative' modifies 'quiet' to indicate that the level of quietness is comparative, not absolute silence. Often used to describe environmental noise standards. In this sentence, it emphasises that residents need quiet relative to daytime activity, not complete silence. Note that 'quiet' is uncountable here.

example.zh: 施工结束后，社区享受到了相对的安静。
example.en: After the construction ended, the neighbourhood enjoyed relative quiet.

meaning.en: Having buildings constructed close together with little open space

usage.zh: 常用于描述城市或住宅区的特征，强调建筑密度高。在本句中修饰‘residential areas’，说明噪声容易传播。通常用于被动语态或作定语，如‘densely built urban areas’。
usage.en: Commonly used to describe characteristics of urban or residential areas, emphasising high building density. In this sentence, it modifies 'residential areas' to explain why noise travels easily. Typically used in passive voice or as an attributive adjective, e.g., 'densely built urban areas.'

example.zh: 在建筑密集的城市，噪声污染是一个主要问题。
example.en: In densely built cities, noise pollution is a major concern.

meaning.en: The levels at which volume is considered acceptable or tolerable by different individuals

usage.zh: ‘threshold’指临界点或门槛，常与介词‘for’搭配。本短语用于解释个体对噪声容忍度的差异。在学术写作中，比‘different ideas about what is too loud’更正式精确。注意‘threshold’的复数形式为‘thresholds’。
usage.en: 'Threshold' refers to a critical point or limit, often used with the preposition 'for.' This phrase explains individual differences in noise tolerance. In academic writing, it is more formal and precise than 'different ideas about what is too loud.' Note the plural 'thresholds.'

example.zh: 人们对可接受音量的阈值不同，取决于他们对噪声的敏感度。
example.en: People have different thresholds for acceptable volume depending on their sensitivity to noise.

meaning.en: Designated times after which certain activities are no longer allowed

usage.zh: ‘cut-off’作形容词修饰‘times’，表示规定的最后期限。常用于规则或政策语境。在本句中指晚间禁止特定噪声活动的时间点。注意复数形式表示多个时间点。
usage.en: 'Cut-off' functions as an adjective modifying 'times,' indicating a designated deadline. Commonly used in rules or policy contexts. In this sentence, it refers to the time points after which certain noisy activities are prohibited. Note the plural form for multiple time points.

example.zh: 市政会设定了施工的截止时间，以减少夜间噪声。
example.en: The council set cut-off times for construction work to reduce noise at night.

meaning.en: To be provided for or adjusted to in a fair and sensible manner

usage.zh: ‘accommodate’意为容纳、适应或满足需求，常与‘reasonably’连用表示在合理范围内满足。本短语用于结论段，表示娱乐和休息需求都能得到合理满足。注意此处为被动语态，主语是‘both recreation and rest’。
usage.en: 'Accommodate' means to provide for or adjust to needs, often used with 'reasonably' to indicate satisfaction within reasonable limits. This phrase in the conclusion means both recreation and rest needs can be met fairly. Note the passive voice with subject 'both recreation and rest.'

example.zh: 新的时间表合理兼顾了早起者和夜猫子的需求。
example.en: The new schedule reasonably accommodates the needs of both early risers and night owls.

prompt.en: In some apartment buildings, residents have little contact with their neighbours. What factors might explain this, and what practical steps could encourage interaction without invading privacy? Write at least 250 words.
prompt.zh: 在一些公寓楼中，住户与邻居很少接触。哪些因素可能解释这种现象？有哪些实际措施能在不侵犯隐私的情况下鼓励交流？不少于 250 词。

title.zh: 同楼居民互不相识
title.en: Limited Contact Between Neighbours

segments.low: In some apartment blocks, people do not talk much with the people who live next door.
segments.high: In some apartment blocks, residents rarely converse with the people living next door.

note.zh: 用更正式的词 residents 替换 people，用 rarely converse 替换 do not talk much，提升学术语体。
note.en: Replaces people with more formal residents and do not talk much with rarely converse, raising academic register.

expressionEdits.before: people do not talk much with the people who live next door
expressionEdits.after: residents rarely converse with the people living next door

explanation.zh: 使用 residents 和 rarely converse 使表达更正式、更精确。
explanation.en: Uses residents and rarely converse for a more formal and precise expression.

translationZh.low: 在一些公寓楼里，人们不怎么和住在隔壁的人交谈。
translationZh.high: 在一些公寓楼里，居民很少与住在隔壁的人交谈。

segments.low: This can be because of different work times and because there are not many places where people can meet without feeling forced.
segments.high: This situation may stem from mismatched work schedules and a lack of low-pressure spaces where neighbours can meet without feeling obliged.

note.zh: 用 mismatched work schedules 和 low-pressure spaces 等更具体的词汇替换简单表达，并用 may stem from 增强衔接。
note.en: Replaces simple expressions with more specific vocabulary like mismatched work schedules and low-pressure spaces, and uses may stem from for better cohesion.

expressionEdits.before: because of different work times and because there are not many places
expressionEdits.after: may stem from mismatched work schedules and a lack of low-pressure spaces

explanation.zh: 使用更精确的名词短语和因果表达，使句子更紧凑、更正式。
explanation.en: Uses more precise noun phrases and a causal expression for a more compact and formal sentence.

translationZh.low: 这可能是因为工作时间不同，而且没有很多地方可以让人们在不感到被迫的情况下见面。
translationZh.high: 这种情况可能源于工作时间不匹配，以及缺乏低压力的空间，邻居可以在不感到有义务的情况下见面。

segments.low: One main factor is that people have very different daily routines.
segments.high: One key factor is that residents often have very different daily routines.

note.zh: 用 key factor 替换 main factor，用 residents 替换 people，并添加 often 使表述更准确。
note.en: Replaces main factor with key factor and people with residents, and adds often for greater accuracy.

translationZh.low: 一个主要因素是人们的日常作息非常不同。
translationZh.high: 一个关键因素是居民的日常作息往往非常不同。

segments.low: For example, a nurse who works night shifts may be sleeping when an office worker is leaving for work.
segments.high: For instance, a nurse on night shifts could be asleep when an office worker is heading out in the morning.

note.zh: 用 on night shifts 替换 who works night shifts，用 heading out in the morning 替换 leaving for work，表达更简洁自然。
note.en: Replaces who works night shifts with on night shifts and leaving for work with heading out in the morning for a more concise and natural expression.

expressionEdits.before: a nurse who works night shifts
expressionEdits.after: a nurse on night shifts

explanation.zh: 使用介词短语替代定语从句，使表达更简洁。
explanation.en: Uses a prepositional phrase instead of a relative clause for conciseness.

translationZh.low: 例如，一个上夜班的护士可能在办公室职员出门上班时正在睡觉。
translationZh.high: 例如，一个上夜班的护士可能在办公室职员早上出门时正在睡觉。

segments.low: As a result, they may rarely meet in the lift or hallway and have fewer chances for a quick conversation.
segments.high: They may therefore seldom cross paths in the lift or corridor, leaving fewer opportunities for a brief conversation.

note.zh: 用 seldom cross paths 替换 rarely meet，用 leaving fewer opportunities 替换 have fewer chances，使表达更地道，衔接更流畅。
note.en: Replaces rarely meet with seldom cross paths and have fewer chances with leaving fewer opportunities for a more idiomatic and cohesive expression.

expressionEdits.before: rarely meet in the lift or hallway and have fewer chances
expressionEdits.after: seldom cross paths in the lift or corridor, leaving fewer opportunities

explanation.zh: 使用更地道的动词短语和现在分词结构，增强书面语感。
explanation.en: Uses a more idiomatic verb phrase and a present participle structure for a more written style.

translationZh.low: 因此，他们可能很少在电梯或走廊遇到，进行快速交谈的机会也更少。
translationZh.high: 因此，他们可能很少在电梯或走廊相遇，留下更少的简短交谈机会。

segments.low: Another possible reason is that some apartment buildings do not have shared areas that feel welcoming.
segments.high: A further possible explanation is the absence of inviting communal areas in some apartment buildings.

note.zh: 用 the absence of inviting communal areas 替换 do not have shared areas that feel welcoming，名词化使表达更正式。
note.en: Replaces do not have shared areas that feel welcoming with the absence of inviting communal areas, using nominalisation for a more formal tone.

expressionEdits.before: do not have shared areas that feel welcoming
expressionEdits.after: the absence of inviting communal areas

explanation.zh: 使用名词短语替代从句，使句子更简洁正式。
explanation.en: Uses a noun phrase instead of a clause for a more concise and formal sentence.

translationZh.low: 另一个可能的原因是有些公寓楼没有让人感觉温馨的共享区域。
translationZh.high: 另一个可能的解释是有些公寓楼缺乏吸引人的公共区域。

segments.low: A shared lobby may exist, but it do not feel like a place where people can stay and talk.
segments.high: Although there may be a lobby, it may feel like a route through the building rather than a place to stop and talk.

note.zh: 修正了主语单复数不一致（it do not feel），并用 route through the building 替换 place where people can stay and talk，使对比更生动。
note.en: Corrects subject-verb agreement (it do not feel) and replaces place where people can stay and talk with route through the building for a more vivid contrast.

translationZh.low: 可能有一个共享大厅，但它不让人觉得是一个可以停留和交谈的地方。
translationZh.high: 虽然可能有一个大厅，但它可能感觉像是一条穿过大楼的通道，而不是一个可以停下来交谈的地方。

segments.low: To encourage more contact without invading privacy, building managers could organise voluntary events.
segments.high: Building managers could offer voluntary activities that encourage contact while respecting residents' privacy.

note.zh: 重新组织句子，用 offer voluntary activities 替换 organise voluntary events，并用 while respecting 使衔接更紧密。
note.en: Restructures the sentence, replacing organise voluntary events with offer voluntary activities and using while respecting for tighter cohesion.

expressionEdits.before: organise voluntary events
expressionEdits.after: offer voluntary activities

explanation.zh: 使用 offer 和 activities 使表达更自然，并避免重复 events。
explanation.en: Uses offer and activities for a more natural expression and to avoid repeating events.

translationZh.low: 为了在不侵犯隐私的情况下鼓励更多接触，楼宇管理人员可以组织自愿活动。
translationZh.high: 楼宇管理人员可以提供自愿活动，在尊重居民隐私的同时鼓励接触。

segments.low: For example, a monthly coffee morning in a suitable part of the lobby could let residents join if they want.
segments.high: For instance, a monthly coffee morning in a suitable part of the lobby could give residents an opportunity to participate voluntarily.

note.zh: 用 give residents an opportunity to participate voluntarily 替换 let residents join if they want，表达更正式且强调自愿性。
note.en: Replaces let residents join if they want with give residents an opportunity to participate voluntarily for a more formal expression emphasising voluntariness.

expressionEdits.before: let residents join if they want
expressionEdits.after: give residents an opportunity to participate voluntarily

explanation.zh: 使用更正式的名词短语和副词，提升学术语体。
explanation.en: Uses a more formal noun phrase and adverb to raise academic register.

translationZh.low: 例如，每月在大厅合适的地方举办一次咖啡晨会，可以让居民自愿参加。
translationZh.high: 例如，每月在大厅合适的地方举办一次咖啡晨会，可以给居民一个自愿参与的机会。

segments.low: Holding occasional sessions at other times would also give shift workers a chance to join.
segments.high: Occasional sessions at different times could also make participation possible for residents who work shifts.

note.zh: 用 residents who work shifts 替换 shift workers，使表达更具体，并用 could also make participation possible 替换 would also give...a chance，更正式。
note.en: Replaces shift workers with residents who work shifts for more specificity, and would also give...a chance with could also make participation possible for a more formal tone.

expressionEdits.before: give shift workers a chance to join
expressionEdits.after: make participation possible for residents who work shifts

explanation.zh: 使用更正式的表达和更具体的名词短语。
explanation.en: Uses a more formal expression and a more specific noun phrase.

translationZh.low: 在其他时间举办不定期的活动也会给轮班工人一个参加的机会。
translationZh.high: 在不同时间举办不定期的活动也可以让轮班工作的居民有机会参加。

segments.low: This does not force anyone to talk, but it gives a chance for those who are interested.
segments.high: This does not compel anyone to socialise, yet it offers an opportunity for those who are interested.

note.zh: 用 socialise 替换 talk，用 offers an opportunity 替换 gives a chance，使表达更正式、更准确。
note.en: Replaces talk with socialise and gives a chance with offers an opportunity for a more formal and precise expression.

translationZh.low: 这不会强迫任何人交谈，但给感兴趣的人一个机会。
translationZh.high: 这不会强迫任何人社交，但它为感兴趣的人提供了一个机会。

segments.low: Another practical step is to put up a notice board in a shared area.
segments.high: A notice board in a communal area would provide another practical way to make contact.

note.zh: 将句子改为以 notice board 为主语，用 would provide another practical way 替换 Another practical step is to put up，使衔接更流畅。
note.en: Changes the sentence to start with notice board and replaces Another practical step is to put up with would provide another practical way for smoother cohesion.

translationZh.low: 另一个实际步骤是在共享区域设置一个公告板。
translationZh.high: 在公共区域设置一个公告板将提供另一种实际的联系方式。

segments.low: Residents could post about borrowing tools, giving away furniture, or starting a book club.
segments.high: Through it, residents could arrange tool loans, offer unwanted furniture or invite neighbours to a book club.

note.zh: 用 arrange tool loans, offer unwanted furniture, invite neighbours 等更具体的动词短语替换 post about，表达更精确。
note.en: Replaces post about with more specific verb phrases like arrange tool loans, offer unwanted furniture, invite neighbours for greater precision.

translationZh.low: 居民可以发布借用工具、赠送家具或创办读书俱乐部的信息。
translationZh.high: 通过它，居民可以安排工具借用、提供不需要的家具或邀请邻居参加读书俱乐部。

segments.low: Residents should choose what to share, and nobody should have to list their flat number or daily routine.
segments.high: Participation should leave residents free to choose what they disclose, without requiring flat numbers or information about daily routines.

note.zh: 将句子改为以 Participation 为主语，使用 leave residents free to choose 和 without requiring 等结构，使表达更正式、更简洁。
note.en: Changes the sentence to start with Participation and uses structures like leave residents free to choose and without requiring for a more formal and concise expression.

translationZh.low: 居民应该选择分享什么，没有人必须列出自己的公寓号或日常作息。
translationZh.high: 参与应该让居民自由选择披露什么，而不要求公寓号或日常作息信息。

segments.low: In conclusion, little contact between neighbours is often caused by different schedules and few casual meeting spots.
segments.high: In conclusion, limited contact between neighbours is often caused by differing schedules and few casual meeting places.

note.zh: 用 limited contact 替换 little contact，用 differing schedules 替换 different schedules，用 casual meeting places 替换 casual meeting spots，使表达更正式。
note.en: Replaces little contact with limited contact, different schedules with differing schedules, and casual meeting spots with casual meeting places for a more formal tone.

expressionEdits.before: little contact between neighbours
expressionEdits.after: limited contact between neighbours

explanation.zh: 使用 limited 比 little 更正式、更精确。
explanation.en: Uses limited instead of little for a more formal and precise expression.

translationZh.low: 总之，邻居之间很少接触通常是由于不同的作息时间和很少的休闲会面场所造成的。
translationZh.high: 总之，邻居之间有限的接触通常是由于不同的作息时间和很少的休闲会面场所造成的。

segments.low: Voluntary activities and simple information sharing can help people connect while still respecting their privacy.
segments.high: Voluntary activities and simple information sharing can help people connect while still respecting their need for privacy.

note.zh: 用 respecting their need for privacy 替换 respecting their privacy，使表达更具体，强调隐私需求。
note.en: Replaces respecting their privacy with respecting their need for privacy for a more specific expression emphasising the need for privacy.

expressionEdits.before: respecting their privacy
expressionEdits.after: respecting their need for privacy

explanation.zh: 添加 need for 使表达更具体，强调隐私作为需求。
explanation.en: Adds need for to make the expression more specific, emphasising privacy as a need.

translationZh.low: 自愿活动和简单的信息共享可以帮助人们建立联系，同时仍然尊重他们的隐私。
translationZh.high: 自愿活动和简单的信息共享可以帮助人们建立联系，同时仍然尊重他们对隐私的需求。

note.zh: 两篇文章都充分回应了题目，解释了原因并提出了不侵犯隐私的实际措施。高版本在表达上更清晰、更具体，例如用 mismatched work schedules 和 low-pressure spaces 等词汇，使观点更精确。低版本内容完整，但部分表达较笼统，如 different work times 和 not many places。两篇均未提供具体数据或研究，但题目未强制要求，因此不构成缺陷。整体上，高版本在任务完成度上略优，但差距不大。
note.en: Both essays fully address the task by explaining reasons and proposing practical steps that respect privacy. The high version is clearer and more specific, using terms like mismatched work schedules and low-pressure spaces for greater precision. The low version is complete but some expressions are more general, such as different work times and not many places. Neither provides specific data or research, but the task does not require them, so this is not a weakness. Overall, the high version is slightly better in task achievement, but the difference is small.

note.zh: 两篇文章都使用了清晰的段落结构和连接词，如 For example, As a result, Another, In conclusion。高版本在衔接上更流畅，例如使用 leaving fewer opportunities 和 while respecting 等结构，使句子间关系更紧密。低版本衔接也有效，但部分句子略显松散，如 Another practical step is to put up 改为 A notice board...would provide 后，与前文的联系更自然。整体上，高版本在连贯与衔接上表现更好，但低版本也达到了基本要求。
note.en: Both essays use clear paragraphing and cohesive devices such as For example, As a result, Another, In conclusion. The high version has smoother cohesion, using structures like leaving fewer opportunities and while respecting to link ideas more tightly. The low version is also cohesive, but some sentences are slightly loose; for instance, changing Another practical step is to put up to A notice board...would provide makes the connection with the previous text more natural. Overall, the high version performs better in coherence and cohesion, but the low version meets basic requirements.

note.zh: 高版本使用了更广泛和更精确的词汇，如 residents, converse, mismatched, low-pressure, inviting communal areas, cross paths, voluntary activities, disclose 等，展示了较强的词汇资源。低版本词汇较基础，如 people, talk, different work times, shared areas, meet, post about 等，虽然正确但缺乏变化和精确性。高版本还使用了更地道的搭配，如 offer voluntary activities, make participation possible。整体上，高版本在词汇资源上明显优于低版本，但低版本词汇使用准确，能够传达意思。
note.en: The high version uses a wider and more precise range of vocabulary, such as residents, converse, mismatched, low-pressure, inviting communal areas, cross paths, voluntary activities, disclose, demonstrating stronger lexical resource. The low version uses more basic vocabulary, such as people, talk, different work times, shared areas, meet, post about, which is correct but lacks variety and precision. The high version also uses more idiomatic collocations, such as offer voluntary activities, make participation possible. Overall, the high version is clearly better in lexical resource, but the low version uses vocabulary accurately and conveys meaning.

note.zh: 高版本展示了更多的语法结构和复杂性，如名词化（the absence of inviting communal areas）、现在分词结构（leaving fewer opportunities）、介词短语（without requiring flat numbers）等。低版本语法基本正确，但有一个明显错误：it do not feel 应为 it does not feel。此外，低版本句子结构较简单，多为简单句和并列句，而高版本使用了更多从属结构和非谓语动词。整体上，高版本在语法范围和准确性上优于低版本，但低版本除一处错误外，语法使用基本正确。
note.en: The high version demonstrates a wider range of grammatical structures and complexity, such as nominalisation (the absence of inviting communal areas), present participle structures (leaving fewer opportunities), and prepositional phrases (without requiring flat numbers). The low version is mostly grammatically correct but has one clear error: it do not feel should be it does not feel. Additionally, the low version uses simpler sentence structures, mainly simple and compound sentences, while the high version uses more subordinate structures and non-finite verbs. Overall, the high version is better in grammatical range and accuracy, but the low version is mostly accurate except for one error.

zh: 使用更正式和精确的词汇替换基础表达，如用 residents 替换 people，用 mismatched 替换 different。
通过名词化和非谓语动词结构增加句子复杂性，如 the absence of inviting communal areas。
注意主谓一致等基本语法，避免低级错误，如 it do not feel 应为 it does not feel。
en: Replace basic expressions with more formal and precise vocabulary, such as using residents instead of people and mismatched instead of different.
Increase sentence complexity through nominalisation and non-finite verb structures, such as the absence of inviting communal areas.
Pay attention to basic grammar like subject-verb agreement, avoiding errors such as it do not feel instead of it does not feel.

taskAnalysis.zh: 题目要求分析公寓住户缺乏交流的原因，并提出不侵犯隐私的鼓励措施。范文采用完全同意的立场，先分析两个原因（作息不同、缺乏公共空间），再提出两个措施（自愿活动、公告板），结构清晰。
taskAnalysis.en: The task requires analysing reasons for limited neighbour contact in apartments and proposing privacy-respecting measures. The sample fully agrees, first analysing two causes (different schedules, lack of communal spaces), then two measures (voluntary activities, notice board), with clear structure.

role.zh: 引言：改写题目，提出两个可能的原因。
role.en: Introduction: paraphrases the question and suggests two possible causes.

analysis.zh: 首段简洁地改写题目，用“residents rarely converse”替代“people do not talk much”，用“mismatched work schedules and a lack of low-pressure spaces”概括两个原因，为下文铺垫。没有明确表态，但暗示了分析方向。
analysis.en: The opening briefly paraphrases the question, using 'residents rarely converse' instead of 'people do not talk much' and summarising two causes as 'mismatched work schedules and a lack of low-pressure spaces'. It does not state an explicit position but hints at the analytical direction.

role.zh: 主体段1：分析两个原因——作息不同和缺乏温馨的公共空间。
role.en: Body 1: analyses two causes—different routines and lack of inviting communal areas.

analysis.zh: 本段先提出“key factor”是作息不同，用护士和上班族的例子说明，指出他们很少碰面。接着提出第二个原因：缺乏温馨的公共区域，即使有大厅也感觉只是通道。论证具体，例子贴近生活。
analysis.en: This paragraph first presents 'key factor' as different routines, illustrated by a nurse and an office worker, noting they seldom meet. It then introduces a second cause: lack of inviting communal areas, where even a lobby feels like a route. The argument is specific and relatable.

role.zh: 主体段2：提出两个不侵犯隐私的措施——自愿活动和公告板。
role.en: Body 2: proposes two privacy-respecting measures—voluntary activities and a notice board.

analysis.zh: 本段先建议建筑管理者组织自愿活动，如每月咖啡晨会，并安排不同时段以照顾轮班者，强调不强迫社交。接着建议设置公告板，居民可自愿发布借用工具、赠送家具或组织读书会等信息，且无需透露门牌号或作息。措施具体可行，紧扣隐私。
analysis.en: This paragraph first suggests building managers organise voluntary activities, such as a monthly coffee morning, with sessions at different times for shift workers, emphasising no compulsion to socialise. It then proposes a notice board where residents can voluntarily post about tool loans, unwanted furniture or book clubs, without revealing flat numbers or routines. The measures are practical and privacy-conscious.

role.zh: 结论：总结原因和措施，重申尊重隐私。
role.en: Conclusion: summarises causes and measures, reiterating respect for privacy.

analysis.zh: 结论段简洁地重申了原因（不同作息、缺乏休闲会面场所）和措施（自愿活动、信息分享），并强调这些措施在促进联系的同时尊重隐私需求。没有引入新观点，收束有力。
analysis.en: The conclusion succinctly restates the causes (differing schedules, few casual meeting places) and measures (voluntary activities, information sharing), emphasising that they connect people while respecting privacy needs. It introduces no new ideas and ends effectively.

title.zh: 使用具体例子
title.en: Use of concrete examples

explanation.zh: 在说明作息不同这一原因时，范文举了护士和上班族的例子（segmentIndex 3），使抽象的原因变得生动具体。护士上夜班、上班族早上出门，可能无法碰面，从而减少交流机会。这种例子贴近生活，易于理解，增强了说服力。
explanation.en: When explaining different routines, the essay gives the example of a nurse and an office worker (segmentIndex 3), making the abstract cause vivid and concrete. A nurse on night shifts and an office worker leaving in the morning may not meet, reducing chances for conversation. This relatable example enhances persuasiveness.

title.zh: 使用让步结构
title.en: Use of concessive structures

explanation.zh: 在描述公共区域时，范文使用“Although there may be a lobby, it may feel like a route through the building rather than a place to stop and talk”（segmentIndex 6）。这种让步结构先承认有大厅，再指出其不足，使论证更加客观平衡，避免了绝对化的表述。
explanation.en: When describing communal areas, the essay uses 'Although there may be a lobby, it may feel like a route through the building rather than a place to stop and talk' (segmentIndex 6). This concessive structure acknowledges the existence of a lobby before pointing out its inadequacy, making the argument more balanced and avoiding absolute claims.

title.zh: 使用情态动词表达建议
title.en: Use of modal verbs for suggestions

explanation.zh: 在提出措施时，范文使用“could offer”、“could give”、“could make”等情态动词（segmentIndex 7, 8, 9），表达建议而非强制，语气委婉，符合“不侵犯隐私”的要求。同时，“should leave residents free to choose”也强调了自愿性。
explanation.en: When proposing measures, the essay uses modal verbs like 'could offer', 'could give', 'could make' (segmentIndex 7, 8, 9) to express suggestions rather than commands, with a polite tone that aligns with 'not invading privacy'. Additionally, 'should leave residents free to choose' emphasises voluntariness.

mistakes.zh: 低分句（segmentIndex 6）中“it do not feel like”语法错误：主语it是单数，助动词应为does，正确形式为“it does not feel like”。高分句改为“it may feel like a route through the building rather than a place to stop and talk”，不仅修正了语法，还使表达更具体。
mistakes.en: In the low essay (segmentIndex 6), 'it do not feel like' is grammatically incorrect: the subject 'it' is singular, so the auxiliary should be 'does', making it 'it does not feel like'. The high essay changes it to 'it may feel like a route through the building rather than a place to stop and talk', which corrects the grammar and makes the expression more specific.

mistakes.zh: 低分句（segmentIndex 8）中“a monthly coffee morning in a suitable part of the lobby could let residents join if they want”表达略显生硬，“let residents join if they want”不够自然。高分句改为“could give residents an opportunity to participate voluntarily”，使用“give an opportunity to”和“voluntarily”更正式且准确传达自愿性。
mistakes.en: In the low essay (segmentIndex 8), 'a monthly coffee morning in a suitable part of the lobby could let residents join if they want' sounds slightly awkward; 'let residents join if they want' is not very natural. The high essay changes it to 'could give residents an opportunity to participate voluntarily', using 'give an opportunity to' and 'voluntarily' for a more formal and precise expression of voluntariness.

meaning.en: to talk with someone

usage.zh: 正式用语，常用于书面语。不及物动词，常与with连用，表示“与某人交谈”。注意不要与“convert”（转变）混淆。
usage.en: Formal word, often used in writing. Intransitive verb, commonly used with 'with' to mean 'talk with someone'. Do not confuse with 'convert'.

example.zh: 住户们很少在电梯里互相交谈。
example.en: Residents rarely converse with each other in the lift.

meaning.en: not matching or not suitable for each other

usage.zh: 常用于描述两个事物不搭配，如时间表、期望等。由动词mismatch的过去分词转化而来，可作定语或表语。
usage.en: Often used to describe two things that do not go well together, such as schedules or expectations. Derived from the past participle of the verb 'mismatch', used attributively or predicatively.

example.zh: 不匹配的工作时间表可能使人们难以见到邻居。
example.en: Mismatched work schedules can make it hard to meet neighbours.

meaning.en: involving little stress or pressure

usage.zh: 复合形容词，由low和pressure加连字符构成，修饰名词，表示环境或场合不让人感到有压力或义务。
usage.en: Compound adjective formed with a hyphen, modifying nouns to indicate an environment or occasion that does not cause stress or obligation.

example.zh: 一个低压力的空间让邻居可以聊天而不感到被迫。
example.en: A low-pressure space allows neighbours to chat without feeling forced.

meaning.en: attractive or tempting

usage.zh: 常用来描述地方或氛围让人愿意停留或参与。由动词invite的现在分词转化而来，但此处为形容词。
usage.en: Often used to describe a place or atmosphere that makes people want to stay or participate. Derived from the present participle of 'invite', but used as an adjective here.

example.zh: 一个吸引人的大厅可以鼓励随意的交谈。
example.en: An inviting lobby can encourage casual conversations.

meaning.en: done willingly, without being forced

usage.zh: 强调行为出于自愿而非强制。常与名词如activities, participation, work搭配。注意与“volunteer”（志愿者）区分。
usage.en: Emphasises that an action is done willingly, not forced. Often collocates with nouns like activities, participation, work. Distinguish from 'volunteer' (a person).

example.zh: 自愿活动让住户可以按自己的节奏参加。
example.en: Voluntary activities allow residents to join at their own pace.

meaning.en: shared by a group of people

usage.zh: 用于描述属于或由群体共同使用的空间、设施等。常与area, space, garden等词搭配。
usage.en: Used to describe spaces or facilities that belong to or are used by a group. Often collocates with area, space, garden, etc.

example.zh: 一个公共花园可以成为住户的聚会点。
example.en: A communal garden can be a meeting point for residents.

prompt.en: Some museums attract visitors from elsewhere but few residents from their own communities. Why might local participation be low, and how could museums encourage repeat visits from residents? Write at least 250 words.
prompt.zh: 一些博物馆吸引外来访客，却很少吸引所在社区的居民。本地参与度低可能有哪些原因？博物馆可以怎样鼓励居民多次参观？不少于 250 词。

title.zh: 本地居民很少去博物馆
title.en: Low Local Participation in Museums

segments.low: Some museums attract visitors from other places but have only a small local audience.
segments.high: Some museums attract visitors from elsewhere while drawing relatively few people from their own communities.

note.zh: 将“other places”改为“elsewhere”，用“while drawing relatively few people from their own communities”替代“but have only a small local audience”，表达更正式、更精确。
note.en: Replaces 'other places' with 'elsewhere' and 'but have only a small local audience' with 'while drawing relatively few people from their own communities' for a more formal, precise expression.

expressionEdits.before: other places
expressionEdits.after: elsewhere

explanation.zh: 使用更正式的副词替代介词短语，提升学术风格。
explanation.en: Uses a more formal adverb instead of a prepositional phrase, improving academic style.

expressionEdits.before: but have only a small local audience
expressionEdits.after: while drawing relatively few people from their own communities

explanation.zh: 用“while drawing”表示对比，更优雅；用“relatively few people from their own communities”替代“a small local audience”，更具体。
explanation.en: Uses 'while drawing' for contrast and 'relatively few people from their own communities' for a more specific, formal description.

translationZh.low: 一些博物馆吸引来自其他地方的游客，但只有少量的本地观众。
translationZh.high: 一些博物馆吸引来自外地的游客，同时吸引相对较少的来自自己社区的观众。

segments.low: One reason is that residents may not find anything new to see, while opening hours can make returning difficult.
segments.high: Residents may see little new material on repeat visits, while inconvenient opening hours can further limit their participation.

note.zh: 将“may not find anything new to see”改为“may see little new material on repeat visits”，更准确；用“further limit”加强逻辑连接。
note.en: Changes 'may not find anything new to see' to 'may see little new material on repeat visits' for precision; uses 'further limit' to strengthen logical connection.

expressionEdits.before: may not find anything new to see
expressionEdits.after: may see little new material on repeat visits

explanation.zh: “little new material”比“not find anything new”更符合博物馆语境，“on repeat visits”明确了情境。
explanation.en: 'Little new material' fits the museum context better than 'not find anything new', and 'on repeat visits' specifies the situation.

translationZh.low: 一个原因是居民可能找不到任何新东西可看，而开放时间可能使再次参观变得困难。
translationZh.high: 居民在重复参观时可能看不到什么新材料，而不方便的开放时间可能进一步限制他们的参与。

segments.low: A permanent exhibition may change very little after someone has already seen it.
segments.high: A permanent exhibition may offer few changes for someone who has already explored its displays.

note.zh: 用“offer few changes”替代“change very little”，用“explored its displays”替代“seen it”，使表达更精确、更生动。
note.en: Replaces 'change very little' with 'offer few changes' and 'seen it' with 'explored its displays' for more precise, vivid expression.

expressionEdits.before: may change very little after someone has already seen it
expressionEdits.after: may offer few changes for someone who has already explored its displays

explanation.zh: “offer few changes”更符合展览的语境，“explored its displays”比“seen it”更具体。
explanation.en: 'Offer few changes' fits the exhibition context better; 'explored its displays' is more specific than 'seen it'.

translationZh.low: 一个永久性展览在某人已经看过之后可能变化很小。
translationZh.high: 对于已经探索过其展品的人来说，一个永久性展览可能提供很少的变化。

segments.low: If people see the same things every time, they may think there is no need to visit again.
segments.high: When the same objects appear on every visit, residents may see little reason to return.

note.zh: 用“When the same objects appear on every visit”替代“If people see the same things every time”，主语更明确；用“see little reason to return”替代“think there is no need to visit again”，更简洁。
note.en: Uses 'When the same objects appear on every visit' for clearer subject; replaces 'think there is no need to visit again' with 'see little reason to return' for conciseness.

expressionEdits.before: If people see the same things every time
expressionEdits.after: When the same objects appear on every visit

explanation.zh: 将“people”改为“the same objects”作主语，与博物馆语境更相关。
explanation.en: Changes the subject from 'people' to 'the same objects', making it more relevant to the museum context.

expressionEdits.before: they may think there is no need to visit again
expressionEdits.after: residents may see little reason to return

explanation.zh: “see little reason to return”比“think there is no need to visit again”更地道、简洁。
explanation.en: 'See little reason to return' is more idiomatic and concise than 'think there is no need to visit again'.

translationZh.low: 如果人们每次都看到同样的东西，他们可能会认为没有必要再次参观。
translationZh.high: 当同样的展品在每次参观时都出现时，居民可能觉得没有理由再来。

segments.low: For example, a local history museum may keep the same old photos and objects for many years.
segments.high: For example, a local history museum might retain the same photographs and artefacts in its permanent collection for years.

note.zh: 用“retain”替代“keep”，用“photographs and artefacts”替代“old photos and objects”，用“in its permanent collection”增加细节，使表达更正式、准确。
note.en: Replaces 'keep' with 'retain', 'old photos and objects' with 'photographs and artefacts', and adds 'in its permanent collection' for formal, accurate detail.

translationZh.low: 例如，一个地方历史博物馆可能多年保持同样的旧照片和物品。
translationZh.high: 例如，一个地方历史博物馆可能在其永久收藏中多年保留同样的照片和文物。
