prompt.en: Some adults return to structured learning long after leaving full-time education. Why do they make this choice? What support would help them continue studying alongside other responsibilities? Write at least 250 words.
prompt.zh: 一些成年人在离开全日制教育多年后重新参加系统学习。他们为什么做出这一选择？哪些支持能帮助他们在承担其他责任的同时坚持学习？不少于 250 词。

title.zh: 成年人重返课堂
title.en: Adults Returning to Structured Learning

segments.low: Many adults return to organised study years after leaving full-time education because they want better work opportunities or a chance to follow an old interest.
segments.high: Many adults return to structured learning years after leaving full-time education, motivated by professional goals or interests they have not yet pursued.

note.zh: 将“organised study”改为“structured learning”，用词更正式；将原因表述从“because they want”改为“motivated by”，更简洁；用“professional goals or interests they have not yet pursued”替换“better work opportunities or a chance to follow an old interest”，表达更精炼。
note.en: Replaces 'organised study' with the more formal 'structured learning'; changes 'because they want' to 'motivated by' for conciseness; substitutes 'professional goals or interests they have not yet pursued' for 'better work opportunities or a chance to follow an old interest', making the expression more refined.

expressionEdits.before: organised study
expressionEdits.after: structured learning

explanation.zh: 用更正式、更常用的搭配替换，提升学术语气。
explanation.en: Uses a more formal and common collocation, raising the academic tone.

expressionEdits.before: because they want better work opportunities or a chance to follow an old interest
expressionEdits.after: motivated by professional goals or interests they have not yet pursued

explanation.zh: 将原因从句改为分词短语，表达更简洁、正式。
explanation.en: Changes the reason clause to a participial phrase, making it more concise and formal.

translationZh.low: 许多成年人在离开全日制教育多年后重返有组织的学习，因为他们想要更好的工作机会或有机会追求旧日的兴趣。
translationZh.high: 许多成年人在离开全日制教育多年后重返系统学习，动机是职业目标或他们尚未追求的兴趣。

segments.low: Both their reasons for returning and the support they receive matter if they are to study alongside other duties.
segments.high: Their motivations and the practical support available both matter when adults seek to continue learning alongside their existing responsibilities.

note.zh: 将“Both their reasons for returning and the support they receive”改为“Their motivations and the practical support available”，用词更概括；将“if they are to study alongside other duties”改为“when adults seek to continue learning alongside their existing responsibilities”，表达更清晰、正式。
note.en: Changes 'Both their reasons for returning and the support they receive' to 'Their motivations and the practical support available', using more general terms; revises 'if they are to study alongside other duties' to 'when adults seek to continue learning alongside their existing responsibilities', making it clearer and more formal.

expressionEdits.before: Both their reasons for returning and the support they receive
expressionEdits.after: Their motivations and the practical support available

explanation.zh: 用更概括、更正式的名词短语替换，避免重复。
explanation.en: Replaces with more general and formal noun phrases, avoiding repetition.

translationZh.low: 他们重返学习的原因和获得的支持都很重要，如果他们要一边承担其他职责一边学习的话。
translationZh.high: 当成年人寻求在现有责任之外继续学习时，他们的动机和可获得的实际支持都很重要。

segments.low: One main reason is that their job changes and they need new skills to get a better position or to switch to a completely different field.
segments.high: Adults may need updated skills to take on a different role with better career prospects or move into another field as workplace requirements change.

note.zh: 将“their job changes and they need new skills”改为“Adults may need updated skills”，主语更明确，语气更客观；用“take on a different role with better career prospects”替换“get a better position”，表达更正式、具体。
note.en: Changes 'their job changes and they need new skills' to 'Adults may need updated skills', making the subject clearer and the tone more objective; replaces 'get a better position' with 'take on a different role with better career prospects', which is more formal and specific.

expressionEdits.before: get a better position
expressionEdits.after: take on a different role with better career prospects

explanation.zh: 用更正式、更具体的短语替换口语化表达。
explanation.en: Replaces the colloquial expression with a more formal and specific phrase.

translationZh.low: 一个主要原因是他们的工作发生变化，他们需要新技能来获得更好的职位或转换到完全不同的领域。
translationZh.high: 随着工作要求的变化，成年人可能需要更新的技能来担任具有更好职业前景的不同角色或进入另一个领域。

segments.low: For example, a factory worker who wants a different kind of job may go to night school to learn coding, hoping this new skill will create more choices.
segments.high: For instance, a factory employee seeking a different kind of work might enrol in evening programming classes to broaden the options available to them.

note.zh: 将“factory worker”改为“factory employee”，用词更中性；“night school to learn coding”改为“evening programming classes”，更具体；将“hoping this new skill will create more choices”改为“to broaden the options available to them”，表达更简洁、正式。
note.en: Changes 'factory worker' to 'factory employee', more neutral; 'night school to learn coding' to 'evening programming classes', more specific; revises 'hoping this new skill will create more choices' to 'to broaden the options available to them', more concise and formal.

expressionEdits.before: night school to learn coding
expressionEdits.after: evening programming classes

explanation.zh: 用更具体、更正式的课程名称替换口语化描述。
explanation.en: Replaces the colloquial description with a more specific and formal course name.

expressionEdits.before: hoping this new skill will create more choices
expressionEdits.after: to broaden the options available to them

explanation.zh: 将目的状语从句改为不定式短语，表达更简洁。
explanation.en: Changes the purpose clause to an infinitive phrase, making it more concise.

translationZh.low: 例如，一个想要不同工作的工厂工人可能会去夜校学习编程，希望这项新技能能创造更多选择。
translationZh.high: 例如，一个寻求不同工作的工厂员工可能会报名参加晚间编程课程，以拓宽他们可用的选择。

segments.low: Another reason is personal interest, as some people always wanted to study history or art but did not have chance when they were young, so they take up these subjects later in life.
segments.high: A secondary motivation is personal interest, since some individuals have long wished to study subjects such as history or art but lacked the opportunity in their youth, and now they can pursue these passions.

note.zh: 将“Another reason”改为“A secondary motivation”，更准确；将“did not have chance”改为“lacked the opportunity”，语法更正确、正式；将“take up these subjects later in life”改为“pursue these passions”，用词更生动。
note.en: Changes 'Another reason' to 'A secondary motivation', more precise; 'did not have chance' to 'lacked the opportunity', grammatically correct and formal; 'take up these subjects later in life' to 'pursue these passions', more vivid.

translationZh.low: 另一个原因是个人兴趣，因为有些人一直想学习历史或艺术，但年轻时没有机会，所以他们在以后的生活中学习这些科目。
translationZh.high: 次要动机是个人兴趣，因为有些人长期以来一直希望学习历史或艺术等科目，但年轻时缺乏机会，现在他们可以追求这些热情。

segments.low: They may join a course just for enjoyment, not for career, and this can be very fulfilling for them.
segments.high: Such learners may attend courses purely for intellectual satisfaction rather than professional advancement, finding great personal fulfilment in the process.

note.zh: 将“They may join a course just for enjoyment, not for career”改为“Such learners may attend courses purely for intellectual satisfaction rather than professional advancement”，用词更正式、具体；将“this can be very fulfilling for them”改为“finding great personal fulfilment in the process”，句子结构更紧凑。
note.en: Changes 'They may join a course just for enjoyment, not for career' to 'Such learners may attend courses purely for intellectual satisfaction rather than professional advancement', more formal and specific; revises 'this can be very fulfilling for them' to 'finding great personal fulfilment in the process', making the sentence more compact.

translationZh.low: 他们可能只是为了享受而参加课程，而不是为了职业，这对他们来说可能非常充实。
translationZh.high: 这类学习者可能纯粹为了智力满足而不是职业发展而参加课程，并在此过程中找到巨大的个人成就感。

segments.low: Schools can offer evening or weekend classes, while employers could adjust work hours when this is possible.
segments.high: Education providers can offer evening or weekend classes, while employers may support attendance through feasible adjustments to working hours.

note.zh: 将“Schools”改为“Education providers”，涵盖范围更广；将“adjust work hours when this is possible”改为“support attendance through feasible adjustments to working hours”，表达更正式、具体。
note.en: Changes 'Schools' to 'Education providers', broader in scope; revises 'adjust work hours when this is possible' to 'support attendance through feasible adjustments to working hours', more formal and specific.

expressionEdits.before: Schools
expressionEdits.after: Education providers

explanation.zh: 用更广泛的术语替换，涵盖大学、培训机构等。
explanation.en: Replaces with a broader term covering universities, training institutions, etc.

expressionEdits.before: adjust work hours when this is possible
expressionEdits.after: support attendance through feasible adjustments to working hours

explanation.zh: 用更正式、更具体的表达替换口语化短语。
explanation.en: Replaces the colloquial phrase with a more formal and specific expression.

translationZh.low: 学校可以提供晚间或周末课程，而雇主可以在可能的情况下调整工作时间。
translationZh.high: 教育机构可以提供晚间或周末课程，而雇主可以通过可行的工作时间调整来支持出勤。

segments.low: For example, a university can offer weekend classes or online modules that students can watch after work, making it easier to fit study into a busy schedule.
segments.high: For example, a university could offer weekend seminars or online modules that students can access after working hours, thereby accommodating their other commitments.

note.zh: 将“weekend classes”改为“weekend seminars”，更具体；将“watch after work”改为“access after working hours”，用词更准确、正式；将“making it easier to fit study into a busy schedule”改为“thereby accommodating their other commitments”，表达更简洁。
note.en: Changes 'weekend classes' to 'weekend seminars', more specific; 'watch after work' to 'access after working hours', more accurate and formal; revises 'making it easier to fit study into a busy schedule' to 'thereby accommodating their other commitments', more concise.

expressionEdits.before: weekend classes
expressionEdits.after: weekend seminars

explanation.zh: 用更具体的术语替换，可能暗示更互动、更学术的形式。
explanation.en: Replaces with a more specific term, possibly implying a more interactive and academic format.

translationZh.low: 例如，大学可以提供周末课程或学生下班后可以观看的在线模块，从而更容易将学习融入繁忙的日程。
translationZh.high: 例如，大学可以提供周末研讨会或学生可以在工作结束后访问的在线模块，从而适应他们的其他承诺。

segments.low: Also, courses should be divided into small parts, so a person can finish one unit and take a break if work gets busy, which may make the workload feel more manageable.
segments.high: Programmes can also be organised into self-contained units, allowing learners to complete one section and pause when work becomes demanding, helping them keep study manageable.

note.zh: 将“divided into small parts”改为“organised into self-contained units”，用词更正式、准确；将“so a person can finish one unit and take a break if work gets busy”改为“allowing learners to complete one section and pause when work becomes demanding”，结构更紧凑，用词更正式。
note.en: Changes 'divided into small parts' to 'organised into self-contained units', more formal and precise; revises 'so a person can finish one unit and take a break if work gets busy' to 'allowing learners to complete one section and pause when work becomes demanding', more compact and formal.

translationZh.low: 此外，课程应该分成小部分，这样一个人可以完成一个单元，如果工作忙就休息一下，这可能会让工作量感觉更易于管理。
translationZh.high: 课程也可以组织成独立单元，允许学习者在工作变得繁重时完成一个部分并暂停，帮助他们保持学习易于管理。

segments.low: This may make it easier to keep studying because they can see progress in small steps.
segments.high: Visible progress through manageable units may help learners stay motivated and resume their studies after an interruption.

note.zh: 将“This may make it easier to keep studying because they can see progress in small steps”改为“Visible progress through manageable units may help learners stay motivated and resume their studies after an interruption”，用词更正式，句子结构更紧凑，并增加了“resume after interruption”的具体好处。
note.en: Changes 'This may make it easier to keep studying because they can see progress in small steps' to 'Visible progress through manageable units may help learners stay motivated and resume their studies after an interruption', more formal and compact, adding the specific benefit of resuming after interruption.

translationZh.low: 这可能会让他们更容易继续学习，因为他们可以看到小步的进步。
translationZh.high: 通过易于管理的单元取得可见的进步可能有助于学习者保持动力，并在中断后恢复学习。

segments.low: In conclusion, adults return to study because of career change and personal interest, and neither reason should be overlooked.
segments.high: In conclusion, career transitions and personal interests both provide reasons for adults to return to structured learning.

note.zh: 将“because of career change and personal interest”改为“career transitions and personal interests both provide reasons”，用词更正式、具体；删除“neither reason should be overlooked”，句子更简洁。
note.en: Changes 'because of career change and personal interest' to 'career transitions and personal interests both provide reasons', more formal and specific; removes 'neither reason should be overlooked', making the sentence more concise.

expressionEdits.before: because of career change and personal interest, and neither reason should be overlooked
expressionEdits.after: career transitions and personal interests both provide reasons for adults to return to structured learning

explanation.zh: 将原因状语改为句子主语，语法更简洁，并删除冗余部分。
explanation.en: Changes the adverbial of reason to the sentence subject, making the grammar more concise and removing redundancy.

translationZh.low: 总之，成年人重返学习是因为职业变化和个人兴趣，这两个原因都不应被忽视。
translationZh.high: 总之，职业转型和个人兴趣都为成年人重返系统学习提供了理由。

segments.low: With flexible hours and manageable units, adults have a better chance to keep studying while also meeting their other duties.
segments.high: Flexible timetables and modular courses can make continued study more manageable alongside work, family and other responsibilities.

note.zh: 将“flexible hours”改为“flexible timetables”，更具体；“manageable units”改为“modular courses”，更正式；将“have a better chance to keep studying while also meeting their other duties”改为“make continued study more manageable alongside work, family and other responsibilities”，表达更简洁、正式。
note.en: Changes 'flexible hours' to 'flexible timetables', more specific; 'manageable units' to 'modular courses', more formal; revises 'have a better chance to keep studying while also meeting their other duties' to 'make continued study more manageable alongside work, family and other responsibilities', more concise and formal.

expressionEdits.before: have a better chance to keep studying while also meeting their other duties
expressionEdits.after: make continued study more manageable alongside work, family and other responsibilities

explanation.zh: 用更简洁、更正式的表达替换口语化短语。
explanation.en: Replaces the colloquial phrase with a more concise and formal expression.

translationZh.low: 有了灵活的时间和易于管理的单元，成年人有更好的机会在继续学习的同时履行其他职责。
translationZh.high: 灵活的时间表和模块化课程可以使持续学习与工作、家庭和其他责任一起更易于管理。

note.zh: 两个版本都回应了题目，回答了原因和支持措施。低分版本原因和支持措施都有涉及，但例子较简单，支持措施只提到灵活时间和单元划分，略显单薄。高分版本原因表述更清晰，支持措施更具体（如独立单元、灵活时间表），但两个版本都未深入讨论如何平衡多重责任，且支持措施部分仍可进一步扩展。
note.en: Both versions address the question, covering reasons and support measures. The low version includes reasons and support, but examples are simple and support measures only mention flexible hours and unit division, slightly thin. The high version expresses reasons more clearly and support measures more specifically (e.g., self-contained units, flexible timetables), but neither version deeply discusses how to balance multiple responsibilities, and the support section could be further expanded.

note.zh: 两个版本都有清晰的结构：引言、原因段、支持段、结论。低分版本使用简单连接词（如For example, Also, In conclusion），但段落内部衔接有时生硬，如第9句“This may make it easier”与前句联系不够紧密。高分版本使用更多样的衔接手段（如thereby, such as, In conclusion），句子间逻辑更流畅，但仍有提升空间，如第10句与第11句之间的过渡可以更自然。
note.en: Both versions have a clear structure: introduction, reasons paragraph, support paragraph, conclusion. The low version uses simple linking words (e.g., For example, Also, In conclusion), but internal paragraph cohesion is sometimes awkward, e.g., sentence 9 'This may make it easier' is not tightly connected to the previous sentence. The high version uses more varied cohesive devices (e.g., thereby, such as, In conclusion), with smoother logic between sentences, but there is still room for improvement, e.g., the transition between sentences 10 and 11 could be more natural.

note.zh: 低分版本词汇较基础，如“get a better position”“take a break”“small steps”，缺乏学术性，但能表达意思。高分版本使用更正式、更精确的词汇，如“structured learning”“professional goals”“self-contained units”“modular courses”“intellectual satisfaction”，词汇丰富度明显提升。不过，高分版本仍有一些常见搭配，如“practical support”“flexible timetables”，可以进一步使用更高级词汇。
note.en: The low version uses basic vocabulary, such as 'get a better position', 'take a break', 'small steps', lacking academic tone but conveying meaning. The high version uses more formal and precise vocabulary, such as 'structured learning', 'professional goals', 'self-contained units', 'modular courses', 'intellectual satisfaction', showing a clear improvement in lexical range. However, the high version still contains some common collocations like 'practical support' and 'flexible timetables', which could be further elevated.

note.zh: 低分版本语法基本正确，但句式较简单，多为主谓宾结构，且有少量语法错误，如“did not have chance”缺少冠词。高分版本使用更复杂的句式，如分词短语、不定式短语、被动语态，语法准确性高，句子结构多样。但高分版本仍有少量可改进之处，如第10句“both provide reasons”的用法虽然正确，但略显生硬。
note.en: The low version is mostly grammatically correct but uses simple sentence structures, mainly subject-verb-object, with a few grammatical errors, e.g., 'did not have chance' missing an article. The high version uses more complex structures, such as participial phrases, infinitive phrases, and passive voice, with high grammatical accuracy and varied sentence patterns. However, the high version still has minor areas for improvement, e.g., sentence 10 'both provide reasons' is correct but slightly awkward.

zh: 使用更正式、具体的词汇替换基础表达，如用“structured learning”代替“organised study”。
通过分词短语、不定式等复杂结构提升句子多样性，避免简单句堆砌。
确保每个段落内部句子衔接自然，使用多样的连接手段，如thereby、such as。
en: Replace basic expressions with more formal and specific vocabulary, e.g., use 'structured learning' instead of 'organised study'.
Enhance sentence variety by using participial phrases, infinitives, and other complex structures, avoiding a series of simple sentences.
Ensure natural cohesion within paragraphs by using varied linking devices, such as 'thereby' and 'such as'.

taskAnalysis.zh: 题目要求分析成年人重返系统学习的原因，并提出帮助他们在承担其他责任的同时坚持学习的支持措施。范文采用四段式结构，先引出话题，再分别论述原因与支持，最后总结。
taskAnalysis.en: The question asks to analyse why adults return to structured learning and suggest support to help them continue studying alongside other responsibilities. The model answer uses a four-paragraph structure: introduction, reasons, support, and conclusion.

role.zh: 引言段：引出话题并概述文章结构。
role.en: Introduction: introduce the topic and outline the essay structure.

analysis.zh: 该段简要介绍成年人重返系统学习的现象，并指出文章将讨论动机和支持措施。高分版本用词更正式，如用“motivated by professional goals or interests they have not yet pursued”替代“want better work opportunities or a chance to follow an old interest”，使表达更精炼。
analysis.en: This paragraph briefly introduces the phenomenon of adults returning to structured learning and states that the essay will discuss motivations and support. The high-scoring version uses more formal language, such as 'motivated by professional goals or interests they have not yet pursued' instead of 'want better work opportunities or a chance to follow an old interest', making the expression more concise.

role.zh: 主体段一：论述成年人重返学习的两个主要原因：职业发展和个人兴趣。
role.en: Body paragraph 1: discuss two main reasons for adults returning to study: career development and personal interest.

analysis.zh: 该段分别阐述职业需求和个人兴趣两个原因，并用工厂工人上夜校学编程的例子说明职业原因，用学习历史或艺术的例子说明个人兴趣。高分版本使用了更丰富的词汇和句式，如“A secondary motivation is personal interest”和“finding great personal fulfilment in the process”，增强了表达的准确性和多样性。
analysis.en: This paragraph explains two reasons: career needs and personal interest, using the example of a factory worker attending night school to learn coding for career reasons, and studying history or art for personal interest. The high-scoring version uses richer vocabulary and sentence structures, such as 'A secondary motivation is personal interest' and 'finding great personal fulfilment in the process', enhancing accuracy and variety.

role.zh: 主体段二：提出帮助成年人坚持学习的支持措施，包括灵活的时间安排和模块化课程。
role.en: Body paragraph 2: propose support measures to help adults continue studying, including flexible scheduling and modular courses.

analysis.zh: 该段提出教育机构提供晚间或周末课程、雇主调整工作时间以及将课程划分为小单元等支持措施。高分版本用词更正式，如“Education providers can offer”和“self-contained units”，并使用了“thereby accommodating their other commitments”等复杂结构，使表达更流畅。
analysis.en: This paragraph suggests support measures such as education providers offering evening or weekend classes, employers adjusting work hours, and dividing courses into small units. The high-scoring version uses more formal vocabulary like 'Education providers can offer' and 'self-contained units', and complex structures like 'thereby accommodating their other commitments', making the expression more fluent.

role.zh: 结论段：总结成年人重返学习的原因，并重申灵活时间表和模块化课程的重要性。
role.en: Conclusion: summarise the reasons for adults returning to study and reiterate the importance of flexible timetables and modular courses.

analysis.zh: 该段总结两个主要原因，并强调灵活时间表和模块化课程能使成年人更好地平衡学习与其他责任。高分版本用“career transitions and personal interests”替代“career change and personal interest”，表达更准确；用“Flexible timetables and modular courses”替代“flexible hours and manageable units”，词汇更正式。
analysis.en: This paragraph summarises the two main reasons and emphasises that flexible timetables and modular courses can help adults balance study with other responsibilities. The high-scoring version replaces 'career change and personal interest' with 'career transitions and personal interests' for greater precision, and 'flexible hours and manageable units' with 'Flexible timetables and modular courses' for more formal vocabulary.

title.zh: 使用具体例子支持论点
title.en: Use of concrete examples to support arguments

explanation.zh: 在论述成年人重返学习的原因时，高分范文使用了具体例子：工厂员工参加晚间编程课程以拓宽选择。这个例子使职业原因更加生动可信，增强了论证的说服力。
explanation.en: When discussing reasons for adults returning to study, the high-scoring essay uses a concrete example: a factory employee attending evening programming classes to broaden options. This example makes the career reason more vivid and credible, enhancing the persuasiveness of the argument.

title.zh: 使用连接词增强逻辑性
title.en: Use of linking words to enhance logical flow

explanation.zh: 高分范文使用了“A secondary motivation is personal interest”来引出第二个原因，以及“For instance”引出例子，使段落内部逻辑清晰，层次分明。
explanation.en: The high-scoring essay uses 'A secondary motivation is personal interest' to introduce the second reason and 'For instance' to introduce the example, making the paragraph logically clear and well-organised.

title.zh: 使用正式词汇和复杂句式
title.en: Use of formal vocabulary and complex sentence structures

explanation.zh: 高分范文使用“motivated by professional goals or interests they have not yet pursued”等正式表达，以及“thereby accommodating their other commitments”等复杂结构，提升了文章的学术性和流畅度。
explanation.en: The high-scoring essay uses formal expressions like 'motivated by professional goals or interests they have not yet pursued' and complex structures like 'thereby accommodating their other commitments', enhancing the academic tone and fluency.

mistakes.zh: 低分范文中的“did not have chance”缺少冠词，应为“did not have the chance”或“did not have a chance”。高分范文使用了“lacked the opportunity”，表达更正式准确。
mistakes.en: In the low-scoring essay, 'did not have chance' is missing an article; it should be 'did not have the chance' or 'did not have a chance'. The high-scoring essay uses 'lacked the opportunity', which is more formal and accurate.

mistakes.zh: 低分范文中的“This may make it easier to keep studying because they can see progress in small steps”表达略显啰嗦，可简化为“Visible progress through manageable units may help learners stay motivated”。高分范文的表述更简洁有力。
mistakes.en: The low-scoring sentence 'This may make it easier to keep studying because they can see progress in small steps' is slightly wordy and could be simplified to 'Visible progress through manageable units may help learners stay motivated'. The high-scoring version is more concise and powerful.

meaning.en: driven by career-related objectives

usage.zh: 用于解释某人做某事的原因，常与“be”动词连用，后接名词或名词短语。注意“motivate”是及物动词，被动语态中需用“by”引出原因。
usage.en: Used to explain the reason someone does something, often with the verb 'be' followed by a noun or noun phrase. Note that 'motivate' is a transitive verb, and in passive voice 'by' introduces the cause.

example.zh: 她受职业目标驱动，攻读数据科学硕士学位。
example.en: She was motivated by professional goals to pursue a master's degree in data science.

meaning.en: current duties or obligations

usage.zh: 指一个人目前承担的工作、家庭等责任。常与“alongside”“in addition to”等搭配使用。注意“responsibility”为可数名词，复数形式表示多项责任。
usage.en: Refers to the duties or obligations a person currently has, such as work or family. Often used with 'alongside' or 'in addition to'. Note that 'responsibility' is countable, and the plural form indicates multiple duties.

example.zh: 许多成人学习者必须在工作与家庭等现有责任之间平衡学习。
example.en: Many adult learners must balance their studies with existing responsibilities at work and home.

meaning.en: improved opportunities for career advancement

usage.zh: 指未来职业发展的更好机会，如晋升、加薪等。常与“with”“for”搭配。注意“prospect”作“前景”讲时常用复数形式。
usage.en: Refers to better opportunities for future career development, such as promotion or higher salary. Often used with 'with' or 'for'. Note that 'prospect' meaning 'future possibility' is often used in the plural.

example.zh: 获得专业认证可以在金融行业带来更好的职业前景。
example.en: Obtaining a professional certification can lead to better career prospects in the finance industry.

meaning.en: a sense of fulfilment derived from mental stimulation or learning

usage.zh: 指通过学习或思考获得的满足感。常与“for”“derive from”搭配。注意“satisfaction”为不可数名词，但可加不定冠词表示“一种满足感”。
usage.en: Refers to fulfilment gained from learning or mental stimulation. Often used with 'for' or 'derive from'. Note that 'satisfaction' is uncountable, but can take an indefinite article to mean 'a feeling of satisfaction'.

example.zh: 他学习哲学纯粹是为了智力上的满足感，而非任何职业优势。
example.en: He studies philosophy purely for intellectual satisfaction, not for any career advantage.

meaning.en: practical or possible changes

usage.zh: 指在实际操作中可行的改变或调整。常与“to”连用，表示对某事物的调整。注意“feasible”意为“可行的”，比“possible”更强调可操作性。
usage.en: Refers to changes that are practical or possible to implement. Often used with 'to' to indicate what is being adjusted. Note that 'feasible' means 'practical and possible', emphasising workability more than 'possible'.

example.zh: 公司对员工的时间表进行了可行的调整，以适应他们的培训需求。
example.en: The company made feasible adjustments to employees' schedules to accommodate their training needs.

meaning.en: sections of a course that can be studied independently

usage.zh: 指课程中可独立学习的部分，通常每个单元有完整的内容和目标。常与“organised into”“divided into”搭配。注意“self-contained”意为“自足的，独立的”。
usage.en: Refers to parts of a course that can be studied independently, each with complete content and objectives. Often used with 'organised into' or 'divided into'. Note that 'self-contained' means 'complete in itself, independent'.

example.zh: 该在线课程分为独立单元，使学生能够按照自己的进度学习。
example.en: The online course is organised into self-contained units, allowing students to study at their own pace.

prompt.en: People increasingly expect digital services to require fewer steps to complete everyday tasks. Why is convenience so important to users? What risks should designers consider when simplifying these services? Write at least 250 words.
prompt.zh: 人们越来越希望数字服务能用更少步骤完成日常任务。为什么便利性对用户如此重要？设计者在简化服务时应考虑哪些风险？不少于 250 词。

title.zh: 人们期待更简单的数字服务
title.en: Expectations of Simpler Digital Services

segments.low: Many people now want digital services to finish everyday tasks in fewer steps.
segments.high: Users increasingly expect digital services to make everyday tasks easier to complete with fewer steps.

note.zh: 将'Many people now want'改为'Users increasingly expect'，用更正式的主语和动词，并调整语序突出'更容易'，提升学术语气。
note.en: Replaces 'Many people now want' with 'Users increasingly expect' for a more formal subject and verb, reordering to foreground 'easier', enhancing academic tone.

expressionEdits.before: finish everyday tasks in fewer steps
expressionEdits.after: make everyday tasks easier to complete with fewer steps

explanation.zh: make tasks easier to complete 直接写出用户希望任务更容易完成的体验。
explanation.en: Make tasks easier to complete directly expresses the user expectation of a less difficult task.

translationZh.low: 如今许多人希望数字服务能用更少的步骤完成日常任务。
translationZh.high: 用户越来越期望数字服务能让日常任务更容易完成，步骤更少。

segments.low: This essay will explain why convenience matter so much and what risks designers need to think about.
segments.high: This essay will first explain why convenience matters so strongly to users, then examine the risks designers must weigh when simplifying these services.

note.zh: 增加'first'和'then'明确文章结构，用'weigh'替代'think about'更正式，并补充'when simplifying'使逻辑更完整。
note.en: Adds 'first' and 'then' to clarify structure, uses 'weigh' instead of 'think about' for formality, and adds 'when simplifying' for completeness.

translationZh.low: 本文将解释为什么便利性如此重要以及设计者需要考虑哪些风险。
translationZh.high: 本文将首先解释为什么便利性对用户如此重要，然后考察设计者在简化这些服务时必须权衡的风险。

segments.low: First, convenience is important because it save users time.
segments.high: First, convenience is highly valued because it saves users considerable time.

note.zh: 修正主谓一致错误'save'为'saves'，并用'highly valued'和'considerable'提升词汇丰富度。
note.en: Corrects subject-verb agreement 'save' to 'saves', and uses 'highly valued' and 'considerable' to enrich vocabulary.

expressionEdits.before: convenience is important because it save users time.
expressionEdits.after: convenience is highly valued because it saves users considerable time.

explanation.zh: 修正动词形式，并将'important'替换为更具体的'highly valued'，同时添加'considerable'强调程度。
explanation.en: Fixes verb form and replaces 'important' with more specific 'highly valued', adding 'considerable' for emphasis.

translationZh.low: 首先，便利性很重要，因为它节省用户时间。
translationZh.high: 首先，便利性受到高度重视，因为它能为用户节省大量时间。

segments.low: For example, a one-click payment or a quick appointment booking let people finish in seconds instead of minutes.
segments.high: For instance, a one-click payment or a streamlined appointment booking allows people to complete a task in seconds rather than several minutes.

note.zh: 用'streamlined appointment booking'替代'quick appointment booking'，更准确地描述简化流程，并用'allows'和'complete a task'提升正式度。
note.en: Replaces 'quick appointment booking' with 'streamlined appointment booking' for precision, and uses 'allows' and 'complete a task' for formality.

expressionEdits.before: a quick appointment booking let people finish in seconds instead of minutes.
expressionEdits.after: a streamlined appointment booking allows people to complete a task in seconds rather than several minutes.

explanation.zh: 用更精确的形容词和动词，使表达更正式且具体。
explanation.en: Uses more precise adjective and verb, making the expression more formal and specific.

translationZh.low: 例如，一键支付或快速预约让人们能在几秒内完成，而不是几分钟。
translationZh.high: 例如，一键支付或简化的预约流程让人们能在几秒内完成任务，而不是几分钟。

segments.low: This is especially useful for busy workers or parents who have many daily duties.
segments.high: This is particularly helpful for busy employees or parents who must juggle multiple daily responsibilities.

note.zh: 将'workers'改为'employees'更正式，'many daily duties'改为'multiple daily responsibilities'，并用'juggle'生动表达同时处理多项任务。
note.en: Changes 'workers' to 'employees' for formality, 'many daily duties' to 'multiple daily responsibilities', and uses 'juggle' to vividly express handling multiple tasks.

expressionEdits.before: busy workers or parents who have many daily duties.
expressionEdits.after: busy employees or parents who must juggle multiple daily responsibilities.

explanation.zh: 使用更正式的词汇和习语，增强表达的准确性和生动性。
explanation.en: Uses more formal vocabulary and an idiom to enhance precision and vividness.

translationZh.low: 这对忙碌的工人或需要承担许多日常职责的父母尤其有用。
translationZh.high: 这对忙碌的员工或必须兼顾多项日常职责的父母尤其有帮助。

segments.low: Second, fewer steps reduce the mental effort needed to use a service.
segments.high: Second, fewer steps reduce the cognitive load required to operate a service.

note.zh: 用专业术语'cognitive load'替代'mental effort'，并用'operate'替代'use'，提升学术性。
note.en: Replaces 'mental effort' with the technical term 'cognitive load' and 'use' with 'operate', enhancing academic tone.

translationZh.low: 其次，更少的步骤减少了使用服务所需的脑力劳动。
translationZh.high: 其次，更少的步骤减少了操作服务所需的认知负荷。

segments.low: When a process is simple, users do not have to remember many options or read long instructions. This matters when someone is tired or using a small screen.
segments.high: A straightforward process can reduce the effort of remembering options or reading instructions, especially when users are tired or working on small screens.

note.zh: 合并两个句子，用'especially when'连接，使逻辑更紧凑；用'straightforward process'和'reduce the effort'提升表达。
note.en: Combines two sentences using 'especially when' for tighter logic; uses 'straightforward process' and 'reduce the effort' for better expression.

translationZh.low: 当流程简单时，用户不必记住许多选项或阅读长说明。这在人疲倦或使用小屏幕时很重要。
translationZh.high: 简单的流程可以减少记住选项或阅读说明的精力，尤其是当用户疲倦或在小屏幕上工作时。

segments.low: However, designers must consider the risk of accidental actions.
segments.high: However, designers must consider the risk of accidental actions when reducing steps.

note.zh: 补充'when reducing steps'，使风险与简化服务的主题直接关联，增强任务回应性。
note.en: Adds 'when reducing steps' to directly link the risk to the topic of simplifying services, enhancing task response.

expressionEdits.before: designers must consider the risk of accidental actions.
expressionEdits.after: designers must consider the risk of accidental actions when reducing steps.

explanation.zh: 明确风险产生的条件，使论点更紧扣题目。
explanation.en: Specifies the condition under which the risk arises, making the argument more relevant to the prompt.

translationZh.low: 然而，设计者必须考虑意外操作的风险。
translationZh.high: 然而，设计者在减少步骤时必须考虑意外操作的风险。

segments.low: If a payment or booking can be done with one tap, a user may confirm by mistake and then find it hard to undo.
segments.high: If a payment or booking can be completed with a single tap, a user might confirm it by mistake and then struggle to reverse the action.

note.zh: 用'single tap'更精确，'might confirm it by mistake'更自然，'struggle to reverse the action'比'find it hard to undo'更正式。
note.en: Uses 'single tap' for precision, 'might confirm it by mistake' for naturalness, and 'struggle to reverse the action' as more formal than 'find it hard to undo'.

translationZh.low: 如果支付或预订可以一键完成，用户可能误确认，然后发现很难撤销。
translationZh.high: 如果支付或预订可以单击完成，用户可能误确认，然后难以撤销操作。

segments.low: For example, a person could accidentally pay for the wrong item because there is no review screen.
segments.high: For example, a person could accidentally pay for the wrong item if there is no review screen before final confirmation.

note.zh: 将原因从句改为条件句'if there is no review screen before final confirmation'，逻辑更清晰，并补充'final'强调确认步骤。
note.en: Changes the reason clause to a conditional 'if there is no review screen before final confirmation' for clearer logic, and adds 'final' to emphasize the confirmation step.

expressionEdits.before: because there is no review screen.
expressionEdits.after: if there is no review screen before final confirmation.

explanation.zh: 用条件句替代原因从句，并添加'final'使场景更具体。
explanation.en: Uses a conditional instead of a reason clause and adds 'final' to make the scenario more specific.

translationZh.low: 例如，一个人可能因为没有审核屏幕而意外为错误的商品付款。
translationZh.high: 例如，如果最终确认前没有审核屏幕，一个人可能意外为错误的商品付款。

segments.low: Another risk is that important information is hidden or ignored.
segments.high: Another risk is that crucial information may be hidden or overlooked.

note.zh: 用'crucial'替代'important'，'overlooked'替代'ignored'，词汇更高级，并用'may be'表达可能性。
note.en: Replaces 'important' with 'crucial' and 'ignored' with 'overlooked' for more advanced vocabulary, and uses 'may be' to express possibility.

expressionEdits.before: important information is hidden or ignored.
expressionEdits.after: crucial information may be hidden or overlooked.

explanation.zh: 使用更精确的形容词和动词，提升表达层次。
explanation.en: Uses more precise adjective and verb to elevate the expression.

translationZh.low: 另一个风险是重要信息被隐藏或忽视。
translationZh.high: 另一个风险是关键信息可能被隐藏或忽略。

segments.low: When terms, fees, or safety warnings are collapsed behind a button, users may agree without understanding what they accept.
segments.high: When terms, fees, or safety warnings are hidden behind a button, users may give consent without understanding what they accept.

note.zh: 用'hidden'替代'collapsed'更常见，'give consent'比'agree'更正式，适合法律语境。
note.en: Replaces 'collapsed' with 'hidden' for common usage, and 'give consent' is more formal than 'agree', fitting legal context.

translationZh.low: 当条款、费用或安全警告被折叠在按钮后面时，用户可能在不理解所接受内容的情况下同意。
translationZh.high: 当条款、费用或安全警告被隐藏在按钮后面时，用户可能在不理解所接受内容的情况下给予同意。

segments.low: Designers should show the final price and purpose before a payment, even if the rest is quick.
segments.high: The final price and purpose should remain visible before payment, even in an otherwise streamlined process.

note.zh: 将主动句改为被动句，使建议更客观；用'remain visible'和'otherwise streamlined process'提升表达。
note.en: Changes active to passive voice for objectivity; uses 'remain visible' and 'otherwise streamlined process' for better expression.

translationZh.low: 设计者应在支付前显示最终价格和目的，即使其余部分很快。
translationZh.high: 最终价格和目的应在支付前保持可见，即使流程其他部分已简化。

segments.low: In conclusion, convenience is important because it saves time and reduces mental effort.
segments.high: In conclusion, convenience matters because it saves time and lowers cognitive effort.

note.zh: 用'cognitive effort'替代'mental effort'，与前文术语保持一致，提升学术性。
note.en: Replaces 'mental effort' with 'cognitive effort' to maintain terminology consistency and enhance academic tone.

expressionEdits.before: convenience is important because it saves time and reduces mental effort.
expressionEdits.after: convenience matters because it saves time and lowers cognitive effort.

explanation.zh: 使用更正式的动词和术语，与主体段落呼应。
explanation.en: Uses more formal verb and terminology, echoing the body paragraphs.

translationZh.low: 总之，便利性很重要，因为它节省时间并减少脑力劳动。
translationZh.high: 总之，便利性很重要，因为它节省时间并降低认知负荷。

segments.low: But designers should also prevent accidental actions and make sure key information is still clear, so simplicity does not harm users.
segments.high: Yet designers should guard against accidental actions and keep key information visible, so simplification does not cause avoidable harm.

note.zh: 用'Yet'替代'But'更正式，'guard against'和'keep visible'更精确，'avoidable harm'强调可预防性。
note.en: Uses 'Yet' instead of 'But' for formality, 'guard against' and 'keep visible' for precision, and 'avoidable harm' to emphasize preventability.

translationZh.low: 但设计者也应防止意外操作，并确保关键信息仍然清晰，以便简化不会伤害用户。
translationZh.high: 然而设计者应防范意外操作并保持关键信息可见，以便简化不会造成可避免的伤害。

segments.low: They also need a safe way to correct mistakes without letting strangers change an account.
segments.high: Recovery options should remain accessible while verifying identity for sensitive account changes.

note.zh: 将建议改为被动结构，更客观；用'recovery options'和'verifying identity'准确表达安全措施，补充'sensitive account changes'明确场景。
note.en: Changes to passive structure for objectivity; uses 'recovery options' and 'verifying identity' to accurately express security measures, adding 'sensitive account changes' for clarity.

translationZh.low: 他们还需要一种安全的方式来纠正错误，而不让陌生人更改账户。
translationZh.high: 恢复选项应保持可访问，同时在敏感账户更改时验证身份。

note.zh: 两篇文章都回应了题目，解释了便利性的原因并讨论了风险。高分版在开头更清晰地预告结构，并在风险部分更明确地将风险与简化步骤联系起来（如'when reducing steps'），结尾补充了恢复选项的具体建议，使任务回应更完整。低分版虽然涵盖了要点，但部分表述较笼统，如最后一句关于陌生人更改账户的建议略显突兀。
note.en: Both essays respond to the prompt by explaining reasons for convenience and discussing risks. The high version previews the structure more clearly in the introduction and links risks more explicitly to step reduction (e.g., 'when reducing steps'), and adds specific advice on recovery options in the conclusion, making the task response more complete. The low version covers the points but some expressions are vague, such as the final sentence about strangers changing accounts, which seems abrupt.

note.zh: 高分版使用更多连接词和过渡短语（如'first', 'then', 'especially when', 'otherwise'），使段落内部和段落之间的逻辑更流畅。低分版虽然也有基本连接词，但部分句子之间缺乏衔接，如第6段两个句子可以合并。高分版在结论中更好地总结了主体内容并给出建议。
note.en: The high version uses more connectors and transitional phrases (e.g., 'first', 'then', 'especially when', 'otherwise'), making the logic within and between paragraphs smoother. The low version has basic connectors but some sentences lack cohesion, such as the two sentences in segment 6 which could be combined. The high version better summarizes the body and gives advice in the conclusion.

note.zh: 高分版使用了更精确和正式的词汇，如'cognitive load', 'streamlined', 'juggle', 'crucial', 'give consent', 'guard against'等，提升了学术性。低分版词汇较简单，如'mental effort', 'quick', 'important', 'agree'，但基本准确。高分版还注意了术语的一致性（如'cognitive effort'在结论中呼应）。
note.en: The high version uses more precise and formal vocabulary, such as 'cognitive load', 'streamlined', 'juggle', 'crucial', 'give consent', 'guard against', enhancing academic tone. The low version uses simpler words like 'mental effort', 'quick', 'important', 'agree', but they are generally accurate. The high version also maintains terminology consistency (e.g., 'cognitive effort' echoed in conclusion).

note.zh: 高分版语法更准确，修正了低分版的主谓一致错误（'it save'改为'it saves'），并使用了更多样的句式，如被动语态、条件句和名词化表达。低分版存在个别语法错误，但整体不影响理解。高分版句子结构更复杂，展示了更好的语法控制。
note.en: The high version has more accurate grammar, correcting the subject-verb agreement error in the low version ('it save' to 'it saves'), and uses a wider variety of sentence structures, including passive voice, conditionals, and nominalizations. The low version has a few grammatical errors but overall comprehension is not affected. The high version shows better grammatical control with more complex structures.

zh: 使用更正式和精确的词汇（如cognitive load, streamlined）提升学术性。
通过连接词和合并句子增强段落内外的连贯性。
注意主谓一致等基础语法，并尝试使用被动语态和条件句丰富句式。
en: Use more formal and precise vocabulary (e.g., cognitive load, streamlined) to enhance academic tone.
Improve cohesion within and between paragraphs by using connectors and combining sentences.
Pay attention to basic grammar like subject-verb agreement, and vary sentence structures with passive voice and conditionals.

taskAnalysis.zh: 本题为原因与风险双问型议论文。需解释便利性为何重要，并讨论简化服务时设计者应考虑的风险。写作应覆盖两个问题，结构清晰，理由具体，风险有实例支撑。
taskAnalysis.en: This is a two-part cause-and-risk essay. It requires explaining why convenience is important to users and discussing the risks designers should consider when simplifying services. The response should address both parts with clear structure, specific reasons, and supported risks.

role.zh: 引言：改写题目并概述文章结构
role.en: Introduction: paraphrase the question and outline the essay structure

analysis.zh: 低分版本直接复述题目，句子简单且略显生硬，如“Many people now want digital services to finish everyday tasks in fewer steps.” 高分版本使用“increasingly expect”和“make everyday tasks easier to complete with fewer steps”等更自然、更正式的表达。第二句低分版本“This essay will explain why convenience matter so much and what risks designers need to think about.”存在主谓不一致（convenience matter），且结构提示不够清晰。高分版本“This essay will first explain why convenience matters so strongly to users, then examine the risks designers must weigh when simplifying these services.”使用“first...then...”明确结构，用词更精准（matters so strongly, must weigh）。
analysis.en: The low version directly copies the question with simple and slightly awkward sentences, such as 'Many people now want digital services to finish everyday tasks in fewer steps.' The high version uses more natural and formal expressions like 'increasingly expect' and 'make everyday tasks easier to complete with fewer steps.' In the second sentence, the low version has subject-verb disagreement ('convenience matter') and unclear structure. The high version uses 'first...then...' to clearly outline the essay and employs more precise vocabulary ('matters so strongly', 'must weigh').

role.zh: 主体段一：解释便利性重要的两个原因（节省时间和降低认知负担）
role.en: Body paragraph 1: explain two reasons why convenience is important (saving time and reducing cognitive load)

analysis.zh: 低分版本论证基本清晰，但语言较平淡且存在语法错误，如“it save users time”应为“it saves users time”。高分版本用词更丰富准确，如“highly valued”“considerable time”“streamlined appointment booking”“juggle multiple daily responsibilities”“cognitive load”。同时将两个简单句合并为更紧凑的复合句，如“A straightforward process can reduce the effort of remembering options or reading instructions, especially when users are tired or working on small screens.” 增强了连贯性和表达效率。
analysis.en: The low version presents clear reasoning but uses plain language and contains grammatical errors, such as 'it save users time' instead of 'it saves users time.' The high version uses richer and more precise vocabulary, such as 'highly valued,' 'considerable time,' 'streamlined appointment booking,' 'juggle multiple daily responsibilities,' and 'cognitive load.' It also combines simple sentences into more complex structures, improving coherence and conciseness.

role.zh: 主体段二：讨论简化服务的两个风险（误操作和重要信息被隐藏）
role.en: Body paragraph 2: discuss two risks of simplification (accidental actions and hidden important information)

analysis.zh: 低分版本指出了两个风险，但表达较为简单，部分句子结构松散，如“If a payment or booking can be done with one tap, a user may confirm by mistake and then find it hard to undo.” 高分版本使用更精确的动词和短语，如“completed with a single tap”“struggle to reverse the action”“crucial information may be hidden or overlooked”“give consent”。同时，高分版本将最后一句改为被动语态“The final price and purpose should remain visible before payment, even in an otherwise streamlined process.” 使建议更客观正式。
analysis.en: The low version identifies two risks but uses simpler expressions and some loose sentence structures. The high version employs more precise verbs and phrases, such as 'completed with a single tap,' 'struggle to reverse the action,' 'crucial information may be hidden or overlooked,' and 'give consent.' It also changes the last sentence to passive voice, making the suggestion more formal and objective.

role.zh: 结论：总结便利性的重要性及设计者应防范的风险
role.en: Conclusion: summarize the importance of convenience and the risks designers should guard against

analysis.zh: 低分版本结论简洁，但用词重复且不够精炼，如“saves time and reduces mental effort”与开头重复，且“They also need a safe way to correct mistakes without letting strangers change an account.” 表达略显口语化。高分版本使用“lowers cognitive effort”替换“reduces mental effort”，避免重复，并用“guard against”“keep key information visible”“avoidable harm”等更正式的表达。最后一句“Recovery options should remain accessible while verifying identity for sensitive account changes.” 将建议表述得更加具体和严谨。
analysis.en: The low version conclusion is concise but repetitive and less refined. The high version replaces 'reduces mental effort' with 'lowers cognitive effort' to avoid repetition and uses more formal expressions like 'guard against,' 'keep key information visible,' and 'avoidable harm.' The last sentence provides a more specific and rigorous suggestion.

title.zh: 使用精准动词提升表达力
title.en: Use precise verbs to enhance expression

explanation.zh: 高分版本使用更具体、更正式的动词替代低分版本中的普通动词。例如，将“find it hard to undo”改为“struggle to reverse the action”，将“hidden or ignored”改为“hidden or overlooked”，将“agree without understanding”改为“give consent without understanding”。这些动词能更准确地传达含义，并提升文章的正式程度。
explanation.en: The high version replaces common verbs with more specific and formal ones. For example, 'find it hard to undo' becomes 'struggle to reverse the action,' 'hidden or ignored' becomes 'hidden or overlooked,' and 'agree without understanding' becomes 'give consent without understanding.' These verbs convey meaning more precisely and elevate the formality of the essay.

title.zh: 运用名词化表达增强正式感
title.en: Use nominalization for formality

explanation.zh: 高分版本将动词短语转化为名词短语，使表达更正式、更简洁。例如，将“reduce the mental effort needed to use a service”改为“reduce the cognitive load required to operate a service”，其中“cognitive load”是学术用语。这种名词化在学术写作中很常见，能提升文章的正式程度。
explanation.en: The high version converts verb phrases into noun phrases to sound more formal and concise. For example, 'reduce the mental effort needed to use a service' becomes 'reduce the cognitive load required to operate a service,' where 'cognitive load' is an academic term. Nominalization is common in academic writing and enhances formality.

title.zh: 合并句子以增强连贯性
title.en: Combine sentences for better coherence

explanation.zh: 高分版本将低分版本中的两个简单句合并为一个复合句，使逻辑关系更紧密。例如，将“When a process is simple, users do not have to remember many options or read long instructions. This matters when someone is tired or using a small screen.” 合并为“A straightforward process can reduce the effort of remembering options or reading instructions, especially when users are tired or working on small screens.” 使用“especially when”连接，使句子更流畅。
explanation.en: The high version combines two simple sentences from the low version into one complex sentence, making the logical connection tighter. For example, 'When a process is simple, users do not have to remember many options or read long instructions. This matters when someone is tired or using a small screen.' becomes 'A straightforward process can reduce the effort of remembering options or reading instructions, especially when users are tired or working on small screens.' The use of 'especially when' improves flow.

mistakes.zh: 主谓不一致：低分版本中“convenience matter”应为“convenience matters”。主语“convenience”是单数，谓语动词需用第三人称单数形式。高分版本正确使用“convenience matters”。
mistakes.en: Subject-verb disagreement: In the low version, 'convenience matter' should be 'convenience matters.' The subject 'convenience' is singular, so the verb must be in third-person singular form. The high version correctly uses 'convenience matters.'

mistakes.zh: 用词重复且不够正式：低分版本结论中“saves time and reduces mental effort”与主体段重复，且“mental effort”不如“cognitive effort”正式。高分版本使用“lowers cognitive effort”避免重复并提升正式度。
mistakes.en: Repetitive and informal wording: In the low version conclusion, 'saves time and reduces mental effort' repeats the body paragraph, and 'mental effort' is less formal than 'cognitive effort.' The high version uses 'lowers cognitive effort' to avoid repetition and improve formality.

meaning.zh: 认知负荷，指处理信息所需的心智努力量。
meaning.en: The amount of mental effort required to process information.

usage.zh: 常用于心理学和人机交互领域，描述用户在使用系统时的心智负担。在学术写作中比“mental effort”更正式。通常与“reduce”“increase”“high”等词搭配。
usage.en: Commonly used in psychology and human-computer interaction to describe the mental burden on users. It is more formal than 'mental effort' in academic writing and often collocates with 'reduce,' 'increase,' 'high,' etc.

example.zh: 简化界面可以显著降低用户的认知负荷。
example.en: Simplifying the interface can significantly reduce the cognitive load on users.

meaning.zh: 精简的，高效的，指流程经过优化去除不必要步骤。
meaning.en: Made more efficient by removing unnecessary steps.

usage.zh: 常用来形容流程、系统或服务经过简化后更高效。通常修饰“process”“service”“system”等名词。注意与“simplified”区别，streamlined强调优化后的高效，而simplified仅表示变得简单。
usage.en: Often used to describe a process, system, or service that has been made more efficient by removing unnecessary steps. It typically modifies nouns like 'process,' 'service,' 'system.' Note the difference from 'simplified': streamlined implies optimized efficiency, while simplified just means made simpler.

example.zh: 该公司推出了精简的预订系统以吸引更多客户。
example.en: The company introduced a streamlined booking system to attract more customers.

meaning.zh: 同时应付多项任务或责任。
meaning.en: To manage multiple tasks or responsibilities at the same time.

usage.zh: 常与“multiple”“several”等词连用，后接“responsibilities”“tasks”“roles”等名词。比喻义，表示在多项事务间平衡。注意不要与字面意思“抛接杂耍”混淆。
usage.en: Often used with 'multiple' or 'several' followed by nouns like 'responsibilities,' 'tasks,' 'roles.' It is a metaphorical usage meaning to balance multiple things. Do not confuse with the literal meaning of throwing objects in the air.

example.zh: 许多父母每天都要同时应付工作和育儿。
example.en: Many parents have to juggle work and childcare every day.

meaning.en: Extremely important or decisive.

usage.zh: 比“important”语气更强，常用于强调某事物对结果有决定性影响。常与“role”“factor”“information”等名词搭配。
usage.en: Stronger than 'important,' used to emphasize that something is decisive or critical. Often collocates with 'role,' 'factor,' 'information,' etc.

example.zh: 清晰的沟通对任何项目的成功都至关重要。
example.en: Clear communication is crucial for the success of any project.

meaning.zh: 表示同意，正式地给予许可。
meaning.en: To formally agree or give permission.

usage.zh: 比“agree”更正式，常用于法律、医疗或数据隐私等语境。通常搭配“to”或“for”。注意“consent”是不可数名词。
usage.en: More formal than 'agree,' often used in legal, medical, or data privacy contexts. Usually followed by 'to' or 'for.' Note that 'consent' is an uncountable noun.

example.zh: 在收集个人数据之前，用户必须表示同意。
example.en: Users must give consent before their personal data is collected.

meaning.en: To take precautions to prevent something undesirable.

usage.zh: 常用于正式语境，表示采取措施避免风险或错误。后接名词或动名词。与“prevent”相比，更强调主动防范。
usage.en: Used in formal contexts to mean taking precautions against risks or errors. It is followed by a noun or gerund. Compared to 'prevent,' it emphasizes proactive protection.

example.zh: 设计者应防范一键支付系统中的误操作。
example.en: Designers should guard against accidental actions in one-click payment systems.

prompt.en: Some consumers now actively choose second-hand goods even when they can afford new products. What motivates this choice? What could sellers do to build confidence in used goods? Write at least 250 words.
prompt.zh: 一些消费者即使买得起新品，也会主动选择二手商品。是什么促使他们这样选择？卖家可以怎样增强人们对二手商品的信心？不少于 250 词。

title.zh: 二手购物的吸引力
title.en: The Appeal of Second-Hand Shopping

segments.low: Many people with enough money still buy used things, and this behavior is not only about saving money.
segments.high: A growing number of consumers with sufficient income deliberately choose pre-owned items, a decision driven by more than financial necessity.

note.zh: 将简单表达替换为更正式精确的词汇，如用sufficient income代替enough money，pre-owned items代替used things，提升学术性。
note.en: Replace simple words with more formal and precise vocabulary, such as sufficient income for enough money and pre-owned items for used things, to enhance academic tone.

expressionEdits.before: Many people with enough money still buy used things
expressionEdits.after: A growing number of consumers with sufficient income deliberately choose pre-owned items

explanation.zh: 使用更正式的名词短语和动词，使表达更精确且学术化。
explanation.en: Use more formal noun phrases and verbs to make the expression more precise and academic.

translationZh.low: 许多有足够钱的人仍然购买二手物品，这种行为不仅仅是为了省钱。
translationZh.high: 越来越多收入充足的消费者刻意选择二手商品，这一决定不仅是出于经济需要。

segments.low: This essay will explain two main motivations for this choice and suggest some ways sellers can make buyers more confident.
segments.high: This essay examines two key motivations behind this choice and proposes practical measures sellers can take to strengthen buyer confidence.

note.zh: 用examines、key motivations、practical measures等更正式词汇替换简单表达，增强学术风格。
note.en: Replace simple expressions with more formal terms such as examines, key motivations, and practical measures to strengthen academic style.

expressionEdits.before: explain two main motivations
expressionEdits.after: examines two key motivations

explanation.zh: 使用更正式动词examines和形容词key，提升词汇层次。
explanation.en: Use the more formal verb examines and adjective key to elevate vocabulary level.

translationZh.low: 本文将解释这一选择的两个主要动机，并提出一些卖家可以让买家更有信心的方式。
translationZh.high: 本文探讨了这一选择背后的两个关键动机，并提出了卖家可以采取的增强买家信心的实际措施。

segments.low: First, buying second-hand goods can help reduce waste and protect the environment, which many people care about now.
segments.high: Firstly, purchasing second-hand goods allows consumers to reduce waste and minimise environmental impact, a concern that resonates with many modern buyers.

note.zh: 通过使用allows consumers to和minimise environmental impact等更精确的动词短语，使表达更丰富，同时保持语法正确。
note.en: Use more precise verb phrases like allows consumers to and minimise environmental impact to enrich expression while maintaining grammatical accuracy.

expressionEdits.before: can help reduce waste and protect the environment
expressionEdits.after: allows consumers to reduce waste and minimise environmental impact

explanation.zh: 用更具体动词allows和minimise替换泛泛的help和protect，提高表达准确性。
explanation.en: Replace vague help and protect with more specific verbs allows and minimise to improve precision.

translationZh.low: 首先，购买二手商品有助于减少浪费和保护环境，这是许多人现在关心的问题。
translationZh.high: 首先，购买二手商品使消费者能够减少浪费并最大限度地减少对环境的影响，这是引起许多现代买家共鸣的问题。

segments.low: When people buy used items, they extend the life of products and stop them from going to landfill too early.
segments.high: By acquiring used items, individuals extend product lifespans and prevent premature disposal into landfill sites.

note.zh: 将时间状语从句改为介词短语By acquiring used items，使句子更简洁，并用prevent premature disposal替代stop them from going to landfill too early，表达更正式。
note.en: Change the temporal clause to a prepositional phrase By acquiring used items for conciseness and replace stop them from going to landfill too early with prevent premature disposal for formality.

translationZh.low: 当人们购买二手物品时，他们延长了产品的寿命，并阻止它们过早进入垃圾填埋场。
translationZh.high: 通过购买二手物品，个人延长了产品寿命，并防止过早丢弃到垃圾填埋场。

segments.low: For example, a person may buy a second-hand sofa not because they cannot afford a new one, but because they want to avoid the waste of throwing away a usable item.
segments.high: For instance, a consumer might purchase a second-hand sofa not from financial constraint but from a desire to avoid discarding a perfectly functional piece of furniture.

note.zh: 用not from financial constraint but from a desire to avoid discarding a perfectly functional piece of furniture替代较口语化的表达，使句子更正式且精炼。
note.en: Replace the colloquial expression with not from financial constraint but from a desire to avoid discarding a perfectly functional piece of furniture to make the sentence more formal and refined.

translationZh.low: 例如，一个人可能会买二手沙发，不是因为他们买不起新的，而是因为他们想避免扔掉一件可用的物品的浪费。
translationZh.high: 例如，消费者可能会购买二手沙发，不是出于经济拮据，而是出于避免丢弃一件功能完好的家具的愿望。

segments.low: Second, used goods can offer unique value, such as vintage style or better quality than similar new products at the same price.
segments.high: Secondly, pre-owned goods can provide distinctive value, including vintage aesthetics or superior build quality compared with new equivalents at a similar price point.

note.zh: 用distinctive value、vintage aesthetics、superior build quality等更精准的词汇替换简单表达，提升词汇丰富度。
note.en: Replace simple expressions with more precise terms such as distinctive value, vintage aesthetics, and superior build quality to enhance lexical richness.

expressionEdits.before: unique value, such as vintage style or better quality
expressionEdits.after: distinctive value, including vintage aesthetics or superior build quality

explanation.zh: 使用更高级的形容词和名词，使描述更具体。
explanation.en: Use more advanced adjectives and nouns to make the description more specific.

translationZh.low: 其次，二手商品可以提供独特的价值，例如复古风格或比同价位的新产品更好的质量。
translationZh.high: 其次，二手商品可以提供独特的价值，包括复古美学或与同等价位的新产品相比更优越的制造质量。

segments.low: Some buyers enjoy finding rare or discontinued items, and this feeling of discovery is a strong motivation.
segments.high: Some shoppers relish locating rare or discontinued pieces, and the thrill of discovery itself acts as a powerful incentive.

note.zh: 用relish locating、thrill of discovery、powerful incentive替换较平淡的表达，使语言更生动有力。
note.en: Replace plain expressions with relish locating, thrill of discovery, and powerful incentive to make the language more vivid and forceful.

translationZh.low: 一些买家喜欢寻找稀有或停产的物品，这种发现的感觉是一个强烈的动机。
translationZh.high: 一些购物者热衷于寻找稀有或停产的物品，发现本身的兴奋感是一种强大的激励。

segments.low: To build confidence, sellers should first give honest and detailed descriptions of the condition of each item.
segments.high: To foster trust, sellers should begin by providing accurate, detailed descriptions of each item's condition.

note.zh: 用foster trust替代build confidence，accurate替代honest，使表达更正式且含义更准确。
note.en: Replace build confidence with foster trust and honest with accurate to make the expression more formal and precise.

expressionEdits.before: To build confidence, sellers should first give honest and detailed descriptions
expressionEdits.after: To foster trust, sellers should begin by providing accurate, detailed descriptions

explanation.zh: 使用更正式动词foster和provide，以及更准确的形容词accurate。
explanation.en: Use more formal verbs foster and provide, and the more accurate adjective accurate.

translationZh.low: 为了建立信心，卖家应首先对每件物品的状况提供诚实和详细的描述。
translationZh.high: 为了培养信任，卖家应首先提供每件物品状况的准确、详细的描述。

segments.low: They should mention any scratches, stains, or missing parts, and include clear photos from different angles.
segments.high: They ought to disclose any scratches, stains, or missing components and include clear photographs taken from multiple angles.

note.zh: 用disclose替代mention，multiple angles替代different angles，使表达更正式精确。
note.en: Replace mention with disclose and different angles with multiple angles to make the expression more formal and precise.

expressionEdits.before: mention any scratches, stains, or missing parts, and include clear photos from different angles
expressionEdits.after: disclose any scratches, stains, or missing components and include clear photographs taken from multiple angles

explanation.zh: 使用更正式的动词disclose和更具体的名词components、photographs、multiple angles。
explanation.en: Use the more formal verb disclose and more specific nouns components, photographs, and multiple angles.

translationZh.low: 他们应该提及任何划痕、污渍或缺失的部件，并包括从不同角度拍摄的清晰照片。
translationZh.high: 他们应该披露任何划痕、污渍或缺失的部件，并包括从多个角度拍摄的清晰照片。

segments.low: This honesty helps buyers understand exactly what they are getting and reduces the risk of disappointment.
segments.high: Such transparency helps buyers know precisely what they are receiving and lowers the likelihood of post-purchase disappointment.

note.zh: 用transparency替代honesty，know precisely替代understand exactly，post-purchase disappointment替代disappointment，使表达更正式精确。
note.en: Replace honesty with transparency, understand exactly with know precisely, and disappointment with post-purchase disappointment to make the expression more formal and precise.

translationZh.low: 这种诚实帮助买家准确了解他们得到的是什么，并降低失望的风险。
translationZh.high: 这种透明度帮助买家准确知道他们收到的是什么，并降低购买后失望的可能性。

segments.low: Second, sellers can offer a short return period or a limited guarantee for used goods.
segments.high: Additionally, sellers could offer a brief return window or a limited guarantee on second-hand products.

note.zh: 用Additionally替代Second增强衔接，用brief return window替代short return period，使表达更自然。
note.en: Replace Second with Additionally to improve cohesion, and short return period with brief return window for a more natural expression.

expressionEdits.before: Second, sellers can offer a short return period
expressionEdits.after: Additionally, sellers could offer a brief return window

explanation.zh: 使用Additionally使段落衔接更流畅，避免重复使用Second。
explanation.en: Use Additionally to make the paragraph transition smoother and avoid repeating Second.

translationZh.low: 其次，卖家可以为二手商品提供短期退货期或有限保证。
translationZh.high: 此外，卖家可以为二手产品提供短暂的退货窗口或有限保证。

segments.low: This shows that the seller believes in the quality of the item and is willing to take responsibility if something is wrong.
segments.high: This signals the seller's confidence in the item's quality and willingness to accept responsibility should problems arise.

note.zh: 将从句改为名词短语the seller's confidence in the item's quality，使句子更简洁正式。
note.en: Change the clause to a noun phrase the seller's confidence in the item's quality to make the sentence more concise and formal.

translationZh.low: 这表明卖家相信物品的质量，并愿意在出现问题时承担责任。
translationZh.high: 这表明了卖家对物品质量的信心，并愿意在出现问题时承担责任。

segments.low: For example, a used electronics shop may allow customers to test devices before buying and return them within seven days if they do not work properly.
segments.high: For example, a second-hand electronics store might permit customers to test devices before purchase and return them within seven days if they malfunction.

note.zh: 用malfunction替代do not work properly，使表达更简洁正式。
note.en: Replace do not work properly with malfunction to make the expression more concise and formal.

translationZh.low: 例如，一家二手电子产品商店可能允许顾客在购买前测试设备，并在设备无法正常工作时七天内退货。
translationZh.high: 例如，一家二手电子产品商店可能允许顾客在购买前测试设备，并在设备出现故障时七天内退货。

segments.low: In conclusion, consumers choose second-hand goods mainly to reduce waste and to find unique value, and sellers can build trust through honest descriptions and reasonable after-sales support.
segments.high: In conclusion, consumers are motivated primarily by environmental responsibility and the appeal of distinctive value, while sellers can enhance trust through transparent descriptions and sensible after-sales support.

note.zh: 用environmental responsibility、appeal of distinctive value、transparent descriptions等更正式词汇替换简单表达，提升结论的学术性。
note.en: Replace simple expressions with more formal terms such as environmental responsibility, appeal of distinctive value, and transparent descriptions to enhance the academic tone of the conclusion.

expressionEdits.before: reasonable after-sales support
expressionEdits.after: sensible after-sales support

explanation.zh: reasonable 与 sensible 在这里都表示售后支持安排合理。after-sales 整体修饰 support，指交易完成后的支持。
explanation.en: Reasonable and sensible both describe a suitable level of support here. After-sales modifies support and locates it after the transaction.

translationZh.low: 总之，消费者选择二手商品主要是为了减少浪费和寻找独特价值，卖家可以通过诚实的描述和合理的售后支持来建立信任。
translationZh.high: 总之，消费者的动机主要是出于环境责任和独特价值的吸引力，而卖家可以通过透明的描述和合理的售后支持来增强信任。

note.zh: 两篇文章都充分回应了题目要求：解释了消费者选择二手商品的动机（环保和独特价值），并提出了卖家建立信心的措施（诚实描述和售后支持）。高分版本在表达上更精确，但内容要点一致。低分版本也涵盖了所有必要部分，但部分表述略显笼统。
note.en: Both essays fully address the task: they explain motivations for choosing second-hand goods (environmental concerns and unique value) and propose seller measures to build confidence (honest descriptions and after-sales support). The high version is more precise in expression, but the content points are the same. The low version also covers all necessary parts, though some expressions are slightly general.

note.zh: 两篇文章都使用了清晰的段落结构和连接词（First/Second/In conclusion等）。高分版本在段落内衔接更自然，如使用Additionally替代Second，避免重复；低分版本连接词使用正确但略显机械。整体逻辑流畅，但高分版本在句子间过渡更平滑。
note.en: Both essays use clear paragraphing and linking words (First/Second/In conclusion, etc.). The high version has more natural transitions within paragraphs, e.g., using Additionally instead of Second to avoid repetition; the low version uses linking words correctly but somewhat mechanically. Overall logic is smooth, but the high version has smoother transitions between sentences.

note.zh: 高分版本使用了更广泛和精确的词汇，如sufficient income, pre-owned items, minimise environmental impact, distinctive value, foster trust, disclose等，展示了较强的词汇能力。低分版本词汇较简单，如enough money, used things, help reduce waste, unique value, build confidence, mention等，虽然正确但缺乏多样性。
note.en: The high version uses a wider and more precise range of vocabulary, such as sufficient income, pre-owned items, minimise environmental impact, distinctive value, foster trust, disclose, demonstrating stronger lexical resource. The low version uses simpler vocabulary like enough money, used things, help reduce waste, unique value, build confidence, mention, which is correct but lacks variety.

note.zh: 两篇文章语法基本准确，句式有一定变化。高分版本使用了更多复杂结构，如介词短语开头的句子（By acquiring used items）、名词化表达（the seller's confidence）等，使句子更紧凑。低分版本以简单句和常见从句为主，语法正确但句式较单一。
note.en: Both essays are grammatically accurate with some sentence variety. The high version uses more complex structures, such as sentences beginning with prepositional phrases (By acquiring used items) and nominalisations (the seller's confidence), making sentences more compact. The low version relies mainly on simple sentences and common clauses, grammatically correct but with less variety.

zh: 使用更正式精确的词汇替代口语化表达，提升学术性。
通过名词化和介词短语等结构使句子更紧凑多样。
注意段落内衔接词的替换，避免重复，增强连贯性。
en: Replace colloquial expressions with more formal and precise vocabulary to enhance academic tone.
Use structures like nominalisation and prepositional phrases to make sentences more compact and varied.
Vary linking words within paragraphs to avoid repetition and improve cohesion.

taskAnalysis.zh: 本题要求分析消费者主动购买二手商品的动机，并提出卖家建立信心的措施。范文采用完全同意的立场，从环保和独特价值两个角度展开，结构清晰，符合雅思写作要求。
taskAnalysis.en: This task asks for an analysis of why consumers choose second-hand goods and how sellers can build confidence. The sample takes a clear position, covering environmental and unique-value motivations, with a well-organised structure suitable for IELTS.

role.zh: 引言段：引出话题并明确文章结构
role.en: Introduction: presents the topic and outlines the essay

analysis.zh: 开篇指出越来越多有经济能力的消费者主动选择二手商品，并点明原因不止于经济因素。随后说明文章将探讨两个主要动机和卖家可采取的措施，为下文做好铺垫。
analysis.en: The opening notes that more affluent consumers deliberately choose pre-owned items, driven by more than financial necessity. It then states the essay will examine two motivations and propose seller measures, setting up the structure.

role.zh: 主体段一：阐述消费者选择二手商品的两个动机
role.en: Body paragraph 1: explains two motivations for choosing second-hand goods

analysis.zh: 本段从环保和独特价值两个角度展开。首先说明购买二手商品有助于减少浪费和环境影响，并以二手沙发为例；其次指出二手商品可能具有复古风格或更优品质，带来发现稀有物品的乐趣。
analysis.en: This paragraph develops two motivations: environmental benefits and distinctive value. It explains how buying used items reduces waste and extends product life, with a sofa example, and then highlights vintage aesthetics or better quality, plus the thrill of discovery.

role.zh: 主体段二：提出卖家建立消费者信心的措施
role.en: Body paragraph 2: proposes measures for sellers to build buyer confidence

analysis.zh: 本段聚焦卖家策略。首先建议提供准确详细的商品状况描述并披露瑕疵、配清晰照片；其次建议提供短期退货或有限保修，并以二手电子产品店为例，说明这些措施能传递卖家对质量的信心。
analysis.en: This paragraph focuses on seller strategies. It recommends accurate, detailed condition descriptions with disclosure of flaws and clear photos, and then suggests offering a brief return window or limited guarantee, using an electronics store example to show how these signal seller confidence.

role.zh: 结论段：总结动机和措施
role.en: Conclusion: summarises motivations and measures

analysis.zh: 结论重申消费者主要出于环保责任和独特价值的吸引力而选择二手商品，卖家则可通过透明描述和合理的售后支持来增强信任，简洁收束全文。
analysis.en: The conclusion restates that consumers are motivated primarily by environmental responsibility and distinctive value, while sellers can enhance trust through transparent descriptions and sensible after-sales support, providing a concise summary.

title.zh: 使用具体例子支撑观点
title.en: Use of concrete examples to support points

explanation.zh: 在主体段中，作者用二手沙发和二手电子产品店的例子来说明环保动机和卖家措施。这些具体例子使抽象观点更生动、更有说服力，符合雅思写作对论证充分性的要求。
explanation.en: In the body paragraphs, the writer uses a second-hand sofa and a second-hand electronics store as examples to illustrate the environmental motivation and seller measures. These concrete examples make abstract points more vivid and persuasive, meeting IELTS requirements for sufficient support.

title.zh: 清晰的段落结构和衔接词
title.en: Clear paragraph structure and cohesive devices

explanation.zh: 文章使用“Firstly”、“Secondly”、“Additionally”等衔接词，使段落内部和段落之间逻辑清晰。每个主体段围绕一个中心论点展开，便于读者理解。
explanation.en: The essay uses cohesive devices such as 'Firstly', 'Secondly', and 'Additionally' to make the logic clear within and between paragraphs. Each body paragraph develops one central idea, aiding reader comprehension.

title.zh: 使用同义表达避免重复
title.en: Use of synonyms to avoid repetition

explanation.zh: 作者交替使用“second-hand goods”、“pre-owned items”、“used items”等表达，既避免了词汇重复，又展示了词汇丰富度，有助于提高雅思写作的词汇得分。
explanation.en: The writer alternates between 'second-hand goods', 'pre-owned items', and 'used items', avoiding repetition and demonstrating lexical range, which can boost the vocabulary score in IELTS.

mistakes.zh: 低分句“Many people with enough money still buy used things”中的“used things”表达不够精确，高分句改为“pre-owned items”，更正式且符合书面语风格。
mistakes.en: In the low essay, 'used things' is imprecise; the high essay uses 'pre-owned items', which is more formal and appropriate for academic writing.

mistakes.zh: 低分句“This essay will explain two main motivations”中的“will explain”略显生硬，高分句改为“examines”，使用一般现在时更符合学术写作惯例。
mistakes.en: The low essay's 'will explain' is slightly awkward; the high essay uses 'examines' in the present tense, which is more conventional in academic writing.

meaning.en: goods that have had a previous owner; second-hand items

usage.zh: 正式用语，常用于商业或学术语境，比“second-hand goods”更中性、更礼貌。通常用作复数。
usage.en: A formal term used in commercial or academic contexts, more neutral and polite than 'second-hand goods'. Usually used in plural.

example.zh: 许多在线平台专门销售经过认证的二手商品。
example.en: Many online platforms specialise in selling certified pre-owned items.

meaning.zh: 最大限度地减少对环境的影响
meaning.en: to reduce the negative effect on the environment as much as possible

usage.zh: 常用搭配，尤其在环保话题中。注意“minimise”后接名词或动名词，英式拼写为“minimise”，美式为“minimize”。
usage.en: A common collocation, especially in environmental topics. Note that 'minimise' is followed by a noun or gerund; British spelling 'minimise', American 'minimize'.

example.zh: 公司应采取能最大限度减少环境影响的措施。
example.en: Companies should adopt practices that minimise environmental impact.

meaning.en: the act of throwing something away before it is necessary or before its useful life is over

usage.zh: 正式表达，常用于环保或资源管理语境。常与“prevent”、“avoid”等动词搭配。
usage.en: A formal expression used in environmental or resource management contexts. Often collocates with verbs like 'prevent' or 'avoid'.

example.zh: 适当的维护可以防止电子设备被过早丢弃。
example.en: Proper maintenance can prevent premature disposal of electronic devices.

meaning.en: the visual style or beauty associated with items from a previous era, often considered classic or desirable

usage.zh: 常用于描述具有复古风格的设计或物品，尤其在家具、时尚领域。通常不可数。
usage.en: Used to describe designs or items with a retro style, especially in furniture and fashion. Usually uncountable.

example.zh: 许多年轻买家被中世纪家具的复古美学所吸引。
example.en: Many young buyers are drawn to the vintage aesthetics of mid-century furniture.

meaning.en: the excitement and pleasure of finding something new or unexpected

usage.zh: 比喻性表达，常用于描述购物、旅行或探索中的愉悦体验。常与“experience”、“enjoy”等动词搭配。
usage.en: A figurative expression for the pleasure of finding something new or unexpected, often in shopping, travel, or exploration. Often used with verbs like 'experience' or 'enjoy'.

example.zh: 寻宝者在发掘稀有文物时体验到发现的兴奋感。
example.en: Treasure hunters experience the thrill of discovery when they unearth rare artefacts.

meaning.en: the feeling of dissatisfaction or regret after buying something

usage.zh: 常用于消费者行为或营销语境，描述购买后因产品未达预期而产生的负面情绪。
usage.en: Common in consumer behaviour or marketing contexts, describing negative feelings after a purchase fails to meet expectations.

example.zh: 清晰的产品描述可以减少购买后的失望。
example.en: Clear product descriptions can reduce post-purchase disappointment.

prompt.en: Some people take a break from paid employment and later seek to return. What challenges might they face? How could employers assess their suitability fairly? Write at least 250 words.
prompt.zh: 一些人在暂时离开有报酬的工作后希望重返职场。他们可能面对哪些挑战？雇主可以怎样公平评估其岗位适合度？不少于 250 词。

title.zh: 职业中断后的重返职场
title.en: Returning to Work After a Career Break

segments.low: Some workers stop their paid job for a time and later want to return to work.
segments.high: Some employees take an extended break from paid employment and later decide to re-enter the workforce.

note.zh: 将简单词汇升级为更正式、更准确的表达，如 workers 改为 employees，stop 改为 take an extended break，want to return 改为 decide to re-enter。
note.en: Upgrades basic vocabulary to more formal and precise terms, such as workers to employees, stop to take an extended break, and want to return to decide to re-enter.

translationZh.low: 一些工人暂时停止了他们的有偿工作，后来想重返工作岗位。
translationZh.high: 一些员工从有偿工作中休了一段较长的假，后来决定重新进入劳动力市场。

segments.low: They may face hard challenges because tools and software change fast, and employers may think the resume gap means skills are old.
segments.high: Returners may encounter unfamiliar tools or software, as well as employers who wrongly treat a gap in employment as evidence of outdated skills.

note.zh: 用 'unfamiliar tools or software' 更准确描述挑战，并加入 'wrongly' 强调雇主的偏见，使立场更清晰。
note.en: Uses 'unfamiliar tools or software' to describe the challenge more accurately and adds 'wrongly' to emphasise employer bias, making the stance clearer.

expressionEdits.before: tools and software change fast
expressionEdits.after: unfamiliar tools or software

explanation.zh: 将原因改为结果，更直接地说明重返者面临的困难。
explanation.en: Shifts from cause to effect, stating the difficulty returners face more directly.

expressionEdits.before: employers may think the resume gap means skills are old
expressionEdits.after: employers who wrongly treat a gap in employment as evidence of outdated skills

explanation.zh: 加入 'wrongly' 表明作者态度，并用 'evidence of outdated skills' 使表述更正式。
explanation.en: Adds 'wrongly' to show the author's stance and uses 'evidence of outdated skills' for a more formal expression.

translationZh.low: 他们可能面临严峻的挑战，因为工具和软件变化很快，而且雇主可能认为简历上的空档意味着技能过时。
translationZh.high: 重返职场者可能会遇到不熟悉的工具或软件，以及一些雇主错误地将就业空档视为技能过时的证据。

segments.low: One challenge is that technology used in jobs changes very quickly.
segments.high: One challenge is that workplace technology may have changed during their absence.

note.zh: 用 'workplace technology' 更具体，并加入 'during their absence' 将变化与重返者的个人经历联系起来。
note.en: Uses 'workplace technology' for specificity and adds 'during their absence' to link the change to returners' personal experience.

expressionEdits.before: technology used in jobs changes very quickly
expressionEdits.after: workplace technology may have changed during their absence

explanation.zh: 用更精确的术语和与个人相关的表述替换笼统描述。
explanation.en: Replaces a general statement with more precise terminology and a personally relevant timeframe.

translationZh.low: 一个挑战是工作中使用的技术变化非常快。
translationZh.high: 一个挑战是工作场所的技术在他们缺席期间可能已经发生了变化。

segments.low: For example, a marketing worker who left before new data tools may not know the latest programs.
segments.high: For example, a marketing worker who left before new data tools were introduced may be unfamiliar with the latest software.

note.zh: 用被动语态 'were introduced' 使句子更正式，并用 'be unfamiliar with' 替换 'may not know'。
note.en: Uses passive voice 'were introduced' for formality and replaces 'may not know' with 'be unfamiliar with'.

expressionEdits.before: left before new data tools
expressionEdits.after: left before new data tools were introduced

explanation.zh: 添加被动语态使时间关系更清晰、表达更正式。
explanation.en: Adds passive voice to clarify the time relationship and sound more formal.

expressionEdits.before: may not know the latest programs
expressionEdits.after: may be unfamiliar with the latest software

explanation.zh: 用 'be unfamiliar with' 和 'software' 替换口语化表达。
explanation.en: Replaces informal phrasing with 'be unfamiliar with' and 'software'.

translationZh.low: 例如，一个在新数据工具出现之前离开的营销人员可能不了解最新的程序。
translationZh.high: 例如，一个在新数据工具被引入之前离开的营销人员可能对最新的软件不熟悉。

segments.low: Also, some employers have a bias against people with a gap in their CV.
segments.high: Another obstacle is employer prejudice against applicants with gaps in their employment history.

note.zh: 用 'Another obstacle' 替代 'Also' 增强衔接，并用 'prejudice against applicants' 使表述更正式。
note.en: Uses 'Another obstacle' instead of 'Also' for better cohesion and 'prejudice against applicants' for formality.

translationZh.low: 此外，一些雇主对简历上有空档的人存在偏见。
translationZh.high: 另一个障碍是雇主对就业历史中有空档的申请者存在偏见。

segments.low: They may think the person lost motivation or ability before asking what the person learned or did during the break.
